800: Leh, hachi hu vadday, ushevacha demoshe aharon umiryam, hava yattir mikkol bene alma, deinnun mitu levar meara kaddisha, demoshe aharon umiryam levar meara kaddisha mitu, vechullehu mitu al yede dehahu mechabbela, bar innun moshe veaharon umiryam, dela mitu ella al yede dekudesha berich hu. aval innun demetin beara kaddisha, la metin al yede dehahu mechabbela, deha ara kaddisha la kayyeyma birshu achara, ella birshu dekudesha berich hu bilchodoy.

Veal da ketiv, (Yeshayahu 26:19) yichyu metecha nevelati yekumun hakitzu verannenu shochne afar vegomer. yichyu metecha, illen demetin beara kaddisha, deinnun metin dileh, vela meachara, dela shalta tamman sitra achara kelal, veal da ketiv metecha. nevelati yekumun, innun demitu beara nucheraa achara, al yede dehahu mechabbela.

Veal da ikrun nevela, ma nevela metammea bemassa, uf innun demetin levar meara kaddisha, metamin bemassa. (nusach acher bemagga) veal da innun nevela. kol shechita deifsil, ikre nevela, begin shechita ha ihi missitra achara, umiyyad deifsil sharya alah sitra achara. uvegin deihi dileh, vesharya alah ikre nevela. veraza da (sefer acher kishmo ken hu) naval hu, (Shmuel 1 25:25) venaval shemo unevala immo.

Veal da bechol atar deihu sharya, ikre nevela. menuval da la sharya, ella beatar pesilu, veal da shechita deafsil, ha dileh hu, veikre al shemeh. uvegin kach, metin deinnun levar meara kaddisha, techot reshu achara, vesharya alayyhu sitra achara, ikrun nevela.

Hakitzu verannenu shochne afar, shochne, dayyrin demichin, vela metin. uman innun. demichin dechevron, deinnun la metin, ella demichin. veal da ketiv behu gevia, keman degavav, veit beh kiuma leanara. uf hachi innun 4 zuge dechevron, demichin innun vela metin, vechullehu kayymu bekiumayyhu beinnun gufin dilhon, veyade sitrin genizin, yattir mishshear bene nasha. genizin havo tamman go pitcha degan eden innun gufin dilhon, veillen innun shochne afar. veal da kol innun denafku nishmatayyhu beara kaddisha, la nafik al yede dehahu mechabbela, vela shalta tamman, ella al yede demalacha derachame, deara kaddisha kayyeyma beadveh.

Atar it beyishshuva, dela shalta beh hahu mechabbela, vela ityeyhiv leh reshu leaala tamman, vechol innun dedayyre tamman, la metin, ad denafkin levar mikkarta. velet lach bar nash mikkol dedayyrin tamman, dela metin, vechullehu metin kishar bene nasha, aval lav bemata. may tama. begin dela yachlin lemetav tadir bemata, ella illen nafkin, veillen alin, veal da kullehu metin.

May tama la shalta tamman hahu malach mechabbela. i tema dela kayyeyma birshuteh, ha ara kaddisha dela kayyeyma birshu achara, umetin, behahu atar amay la metin. i tema begin kedushsha, let atar bikdusha bechol yishuva kegavvna deeretz yisrael. vei tema, begin hahu gavra devane lah. kama bene nasha havo dizchutehon yattir midileh. amar rabbi yitzchak, ana la shemana vela ema.

Atu shaillu leh lerabbi shimon, amar lon, vadday hahu atar la shalta aleh malach hammavet, vekudesha berich hu la bae divhahu atar yemut bar nash lealmin, vei tema, dekodem lachen behahu ducheta, ad la itbene, mitu beh bene nasha, lav hachi. ella miyyoma deitbere alma, ittakkan hahu atar, lekiyyuma, veraza derazin hacha, leinnun demistakkele beraza dechachmeta.

Kad bara kudesha berich hu alma, bara leh beraza (mikketz 204 amud alef) deatvavn, veitgalgelu atvavn, uvara alma, begillufe dishma kaddisha. itgalgelu atvavn, veascharu alma begillufe vechad itgele veitpashshat alma veitbere, vahavu atvavn sacharan lemivre, amar kudesha berich hu deyistayyem beYod, ishtearat at 9 (nusach acher ytegalegalev atvavn, veascharu alma begillufa dishma kaddisha vechad ategalegalev atvavn vahavo sacharan lemivre, ameraz kudesha berich hu di yistayem beYod, ishtearat et 9 bilchodaha) behahu ducheta,
801: Talya baavera, kevan deamar kudesha berich hu day yistayyem beYod, ishtearat at tet bilchodaha talya baavera al gabbe hahu ducheta tet, ihu at, dinhiru chayyin, begin kach, man dechame tet bechelmeh, simana tava hu leh, vechayyin ittakanu leh. veal da begin dehava 9 talya al gabbe hahu atar, la shalta beh mota.

Kad baa kudesha berich hu lekayyeyma alma, zarik chad tzerora go mayya, galif beraza dev (nusach acher 26) atvavn, umittamman shaari lemehach hahu tzerora, vela ashkach atar leitkayyeyma beh, bar ara kaddisha, (nusach acher beve makdesha) umayya havo azlin avatreh, ad demata hahu tzerora techot hammizbeach, vetamman ishteka, veitkayyaym kol alma.

Vei tema, i hachi divhahu atar sharyayn chayyim, amay la itbene tamman be makdesha, lemehav chayyin leyatvaha. ella hacha behay atar itkayyaym begin at chad desharya aleh. beve makdesha kol atvavn kullehu sharan beh, uvehu itbere ihu bilchodoy, kegavvna dechol alma.

Vetu, deara kaddisha (nusach acher beve makdesha) yahiv chayyin vechappara leyatvaha behahu alma, vaatar da lav hachi, yahiv chayyin lehahu atar behay (Bereshit 50 amud alef, lekamman 230 amud alef) alma, vela bealma deate. uve makdesha behippucha mittamman, begin deit chulaka leyisrael behahu alma, vela bealma da. veal da kayyeyma be makdesha lechappara chovin, ulemizke lon leyisrael lealma deate.

Ta chaze, tet nehiru dechayyin bechol atar, veal da patach bah kera ki tov. dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:4) vayyar elohim et haor ki tov. mehay at, (nusach acher meatar da) arik malacha mechabbela. la tema arik, ella dela ityeyhiv leh reshu leaala tamman.

At da meshanya meat 100, 100 la mityayshsheva (nusach acher meet 8, 8 lo mityayshsheva) kelal beducheta bealma, vesimanich (Tehillim 140:12) ish lashon bal yikkon baaretz at tet ityayshva bechol ducheta, veittakkanat leityayshsheva kedka yeot, ubbegin kach bechol ducheta deat 9 tamman, let yishuva leat 100 tamman leityayshsheva beh. veal da atar da la shalta beh kelal sitra achara, veyahiv chayyim dehay alma leyatve techoteh deat da, vela yippuk levar, vechad nafik levar, it reshu lesitra achara leshalletaa beh. kema deat da shalta beatar da, hachi name shalta at achara beatar degehinnam, uman ihi, (180 amud bet) at 100.

Uvesifra derav hamenuna sava, hacha innun teren atvavn: 8, 9. veal da la havo ketivin go avni burela, avanin deashlamuta, ushevatin deyisrael, teren atvavn illen itmenau minnayyhu, begin dela yehe rashim begavvavyyhu chet.

Beatar deve makdesha talyayn kol atvavn dealfa beta, berazin gelifan dishmahan kaddishin, keshirin, merukkaman aleh, vechol alma dilella vetatta, kolla beraza deatvavn mitchamman (nusach acher mitchakkekan) uggelifa, verazin dikdusha (sefer acher dishma kaddisha) illaa, alayyhu itgelif.

Bemashkena itgelifu veittzayayru atvavn kadka chazi. deha betzalel hava yada chachmeta, letzarfa atvavn deitberiu behu shemaya veara. veal chachmeta dileh, (nusach acher da) itbene mashkena al yedeh, veitberir mikkol amma deyisrael.

Uchema deihu itberir leella, hachi baa kudesha berich hu deyitberir letatta. leella ketiv, (Shemot 31:2) ree karati veshem betzalel. letatta (Shemot 35:30) reu kara Adonai beshem betzalel. ushemeh beraza illaa ikre hachi betzalel: betzel el. uman ihu. da tzaddik. deihu yativ betzel el, hahu deikre el (lecha lecha 77 amud alef) elyon. veihu yativ kegavvna dehahu el. hahu el natil shit sitrin, hahu tzaddik natil lon. uf hachi, hahu el anhir leella, hay tzaddik anhir letatta. hahu el, kelala dechullehu shit sitrin. hahu tzaddik, kelala dechullehu shit sitrin.
Ben uri: ben or kadmaa, devara kudesha berich hu beovada divreshit. ben chur: ben chiru decholla. davar acher, ben chur: ben chivvavr mikkol gavvnin. veda itmane lematte yehuda, kolla kadka yeot.

Kol gavvnin tavin lechelma, bar tichla, kema (139 amud alef) deittemar. begin deihu kurseyay, lemedan dinin denishmatin. veha hay darga (nusach acher chada) chivvavra ihu. ella beshaata dekayyeyma bedine denafshan, kedin ihu gon tichla. veha
802: Beshaata dechame bar nash lehay gon, idkar bar nash lemebad pikkudin demareh. kegavvna dinchash hannechoshet, beshaata dahavo chaman leh, havo dachale mikkamme dekudesha berich hu, umenatran garmayyhu mikkol chovin, uveshaata dehahu dechilu dekudesha berich hu salleka alayyhu, miyyad ittasyayn. man garim lon ledachala mikkame kudesha berich hu, hahu nachash, hahi retzua demistakkelan bah. uf hachi techelet (Bamidbar 15:39) ureitem oto uzzechartem et kol mitzvot Adonai. mehahu dechilu dileh, veal da techelet bemashkena.

Amar rabbi yitzchak, hay deamar mar techelet kurseyay dedina ihi, vechad ihi kayyeyma begavvna da, keden ihi kurseyay lemedan dine nafshan. ematay ihi berachame. amar leh, beshaata dichruvim mehaderan anpayyhu da im da, umistakkelan anpin beanpin. kevan deinnun keruvim mistakkelan anpin beanpin keden kol gavvnin mittaknan, veithappach gon tichla legavvn achara. mithappach gon yarok, legavvn zahav.

(Nusach acher chivvavr) veal da, behippucha digvavnin, ithappach middina lerachame, vechen merachame ledina, vecholla behippucha digvavnin. kema dimsadrin yisrael tikkunayyhu legabbe kudesha berich hu, hachi kayyayma kolla, vehachi itsadar. veal da ketiv (Yeshayahu 49:3) yisrael asher becha etpaar, beinnun gavvnin dichlilan da beda, shefiru dechullehu. (chaser kan)

(Shemot 25:23) veasita shulchan atze shittim vegomer. rabbi yitzchak patach, (Devarim 8:10) veachalta veshavata uverachta et Adonai elohecha vegomer, kama zakkain innun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu itree behu, vekariv lon legabbeh mikkol ammin, uveginehon deyisrael, yahiv mezona vesava, lechol alma. veilmale yisrael, la yahiv kudesha berich hu mezona lealma, vehasheta deyisrael innun begaluta, al achat kamma vechamma denatle mezona al chad teren.

Bezimna dahavo yisrael beara kaddisha, hava nachit lon mezona meatar illaa, veinnun yahave cholak tamtzit leammin ovde kochavim, veammin kullehu la ittezanu ella mittamtzit. vehasheta deyisrael innun begaluta, ithappach begavvna achara.

Metal lemalka, deatkin seudata livne beteh, kol zimna deinnun avde reuteh, achle seudata im malka, veyahave lechalbe chulak garmin lemigrar. beshaata divni beteh la avde reuta demalka, malka yahiv kol seudata lechalbe, vesalik lon garme.

Kegavvna da, kol zimna deyisrael avde reuta demarehon, ha al patora demalka innun achle, vechol seudata ittakkan lehon. veinnun, mehahu chedva dilhon, yahave garme deihu tamtzit leovade kochavim. vechol zimna deyisrael la avde reuta demarehon, azle begaluta, veha seudata lechalbe, veistallak lon tamtzit (Yechezkel 4:13) kacha yochlu bene yisrael et lachmam tame baggoyim, deha tamtzit degiulehon achle. vavy livra demalka, deyativ umetzappe lefatora deavda, ma deishtear miggo patora ihu achil.

David malka amar, (Tehillim 23:5) taaroch lefanay shulchan neged tzorray dishshanta vashshemen roshi kosi revaya. taaroch lefanay shulchan, da seudata demalka. neged tzorray, innun kalbe deyatve kame patora, metzappan lechulak garmin, veihu yativ im malka beinuga disudata befatora.

Dishshanta vashshemen roshi, da resha disudata, dechol mishcha, veshamnuna, vetikun seudata, ityeyhiv bekadmita lirchima demalka. ma deishtear, levatar ityeyhiv lechalbe, uleinnun palche patora. kosi revaya, malya kassa kame rechima demalka tadir, dela yitzterich lemishal. veal raza da, havo yisrael tadir, im shear ammin.

Rabbi chiyyay hava azil legabbe derabbi shimon litverya, vahavu immeh rabbi yaakov bar idi, verabbi yesa zeira, ad dahavo azle, amar rabbi yesa lerabbi chiyyay, tema ma dichtiv, (Melachim 1 2:7) velivnay varziyylay haggiladi taase chesed vehayu beochle shulchanecha vegomer. i hachi kol tivu ukeshot, lemechal al patoreh vela yattir, middekaamar hacha vehayu beochle shulchancha. vetu, lav yekara demalka ihu, lemechal bar nash ochora
803: Al patoreh demalka, vela itzterich da, ella malka bilchodoy, vechullehu ravrevanohi sacharaneh, letatta minneh.

Amar rabbi chiyyay la shemana behay midi, vela ema. amar leh lerabbi yaakov bar idi, veat shamata behay midi. amar leh, attun deyankin bechol yoma midduvsha demishcha illaa, la shematun, kol shekken ana. amar leh lerabbi yesa, veat shamata midi behay. amar leh af al gav daana ravya umiyyomin zeirin atena legabbayychu, vela zachena mikkadmat dena, ana shemana.

Patach veamar (Tehillim 136:25) noten lechem lechol basar ki leolam chasdo. may ka chama david desium hallela rabba, siyyem hachi behay kera. ella telat shallitin innun leella, dekudesha berich hu ishtemoda behu, veinnun raza yakkira dileh, veillen innun: mocha, velibba, vechavda. veinnun behippucha dehay alma. leella, mocha natil beresha, uvatar yahiv lelibba, velibba natil veyahiv lechavda, ulevatar kavda yahiv chulak lechol innun mekorin diltatta, kol chad vechad kadka chazi leh. letatta, kavda natil beresha, ulevatar ihu mekarav kolla lelibba, venatil libba shefiru demechla. kevan denatil, veittakaf mehahu tukpa ureu deka natil, yahiv veittear legabbe mocha. ulevatar ahdar kavda, ufalig mezona lechol mekorin degufa. (beyoma davar nash ittear betaanita, ittear leella kegavvna hahu mammash, uveyoma desava, lav hachi)

Beyoma detaanita, bar nash mekarav mechla umishteyya legabbe kavda illaa, umay ihu mekarav. chelbeh vedameh ureuteh. hahu kavda natil kolla biruta. kevan decholla ihu legabbeh, natil umekarav kolla lekame libba, deihu rav veshalit aleh. kevan delibba natil veittakaf beraava, mekarev kolla legabbe mocha, deihu shallita illaa al kol gufa, levatar ahdar kavda umefaleg chulakin lechol innun mekorin veshayyfin diltatta. bezimna achara, kad (davar acher kolla) mocha natil bekadmita, ulevatar yahiv lelibba, velibba yahiv lechavda, vechavda yahiv lechullehu mekorin veshayyfin diltatta, ulevatar kad bae lefallega mezona lehay alma, beresha yahiv lelibba, deihu malka di beara. ufatora demalka, ittear bekadmita mikkol shear bene alma.
Zakkaa ihu, man dahave bechushebana defatora demalka, deha ishtemoda leotava leh behahu tivu dilella.

(Uvegine kach) veda ihu tivu ukeshot, daavad david livne varziyylay, dichtiv vehayu beochle shulchanecha. vei tema divshulchana demalka, achil bar nash ochora bar minneh. la. ella malka achil beresha, uvatar kol amma. veinnun deachle im malka, beshaata deihu achil innun dechavivin aleh mikkullehu, veinnun itmenun mishulchana demalka.

Vei tema, ha ketiv, (Shmuel 2 9:13) al shulchan hammelech tamid hu ochel. begin dechol mezona dileh, la avid chushebana ochora, ella al shulchan hammelech, demittamman hava ate mezona umechla dileh. veda ihu al shulchan hammelech tamid hu ochel. ata rabbi chiyyay, uneshakeh al resheh, amar leh ravya ant, vechachmeta illaa sharya belibbach. addehachi, chamu leh lerabbi chizkiyya dehava ate. amar leh rabbi chiyyay, vadday bechavruta da, kudesha berich hu yitchabbar alana, deha millin chadtin deorayyta yitchadtun hacha.

Yatvu lemechal. amru, kol chad vechad lema mille deorayyta behay seudata, amar rabbi yesa, seudat aray ihi, veim kol da seuda ikre. vela od, ella dehay ikre seudata dekudesha berich hu ithane minnah. veal da ketiv, (Yechezkel 41:22) ze hashshulchan asher lifne Adonai, deha millin deorayyta yischarun lehay atar.

Patach rabbi chiyyay veamar, (Devarim 8:10) veachalta veshavata uverachta et Adonai elohecha vegomer. vechi ad la achil bar nash lesava, veyitmele keriseh, la yevarech leh lekudesha berich hu, (davar acher 33 i hachi)
804: Bemay nokim veachalta veshavata, uvatar uverachta. ella afillu la yechul bar nash ella kezayit, ureuteh ihu aleh, veyishave leh lehahu mechla ikara demechleh, sava ikre. dichtiv, (Tehillim 145:16) poteach et yadecha umasbia lechol chay ratzon. lechol chay achila la ketiv, ella ratzon. hahu reuta deshavve al hahu mechla, sava ikre, vaafillu delet kameh devar nash ella hahu zeer bichzayit, vela yattir ha reuta desava shavve aleh. uvegin kach, umasbia lechol chay ratzon, ratzon ketiv, vela achila. veal da uverachta vadday, veitchayayv bar nash levarcha leh lekudesha berich hu, begin lemehav chedva leella.

Patach rabbi chizkiyya, behay kera avatreh veamar, veachalta veshovata. mehacha, deshikkor share leh levarcha bircheta dimzona, (vayyiggash 207 amud bet) ma delet hachi bitzlota. ditzlota lav hachi, deha tzelota maalya bela achila ihi, may taama, begin ditzlota salleka leella leella, atar delet beh la achila vela shetiyya. veal da taninan, alma deate let beh achila ushetiyya vechulei.

Aval shear dargin diltatta it bevirkat mezona, ishtechach gavvna ochora umaalya, hahu bircheta deishtechach besava. begin devirkat mezona, ihi baatar deit beh achila ushetiyya, uminneh nafak mezona vesava letatta, veal da itzterich leachazaa kameh sava vechedva. (uvegin kach hay ihu atar deit beh achila ushetiyya uminneh nafik mezona letatta veitzterich leachazaa kammeh shava vechedva) baatar ditzlota, lav hachi, deha salleka yattir leella leella veal da, shikkor la yitzle tzelota.

Bevirkat mezona, shikkor share leh levarcha birkat mezona. mashma mehay kera, dichtiv veachalta veshavata uverachta. veachalta: zo achila. vesavata: zo shetiyya deha sava, bechamra ihi ravve. chamra sava vadday, veda ihu shikkor. dichtiv uverachta et dayyka, demashma devirkat mezona itzterich chedva vesava. al haaretz hattova. may tova. sava. kema deat amer, (yirmeya ma) vannisba lechem vannihye tovim begin kach itzterich chedva vesava.

Patach rabbi yesa veamar (Shemot 25:23) veasita shulchan atze shittim vegomer, shulchan da ihu kayyeyma lego bemashkena. uvircheta dilella sharya aleh, uminneh nafik mezona lechol alma. veshulchan da la itzterich lemeheve berekanyya, afillu riga chada, ella lemeheve aleh mezona, deha bircheta la ishtechach al atar rekanayya. uvegin kach itzterich lemehve aleh nahama tadir, delehve tadir bircheta illaa mishtakkecha beh, umiggo hahu shulchan, nafke birkan umezone lechol shear patori dealma, deitbarchan begineh.

Shulchan dechol bar nash itzterich lemeheve hachi kameh, beshaata deka mevarach leh lekudesha berich hu, begin detishre aleh bircheta milleella, vela yitchaze berekanyya, deha birkan dilella la sharyayn beatar rekanayya, dichtiv, (Melachim 2 4:2) haggidi li ma yesh lachy babbayit, veha ukemuha chavrayyay.

Shulchan dela ittemar aleh mille deorayyta, (63 eno, velo berich al hahu mezona lekudesha berich hu) aleh ketiv, (Yeshayahu 28:8) ki kol shulchanot malu ki tzoa beli makom. veasur levarcha al hahu shulchan. may tama. begin deit shulchan, veit shulchan. shulchan ihu deka mesaddera kameh dekudesha berich hu leella, veihu kayyeyma tadir lesaddera beh pitgame orayyta, uleachlela beh atvavn demille deorayyta, (63 eno, da hu bircheta dimzona, deit pesuke umele deorayta veinnun atvavn demalle orayyta itteklilan beh behahu shulchan) veihu lakit lon legabbeh, vechalil kullehu begavveh, uvehu ishtelim, vechadde, veit leh chedva. veal shulchan da ketiv, (Yechezkel 41:22) ze hashshulchan asher lifne Adonai, lifne Adonai, vela (102 amud bet) milifne Adonai.
Shulchan achara it, dela it beh chulaka deorayyta, velet leh chulaka bikdusha deorayyta, vehahu shulchan ikre ki tzoa, veda ihu beli
805: Makom, delet leh chulaka besitra dikdusha kelum. begin kach, shulchan dela ittemar aleh mille deorayyta, ihu shulchan deki tzoa. ihu shulchan detaava achara. let behahu shulchan chulaka beraza deelaha illaa.

Shulchan demille orayyta ittemaru aleh, kudesha berich hu natil hahu shulchan, veshavvi leh lechulekeh. vela od, (203 74, 223 amud alef) ella sureya rav memana, natil kol innun millin, veshavve diyyukena dehahu shulchan kame kudesha berich hu. vechol innun millin deorayyta deitmaru aleh, sallekin al hahu patora, veitattar (sefer acher veitattad) kame malka kaddisha. mashma dichtiv ze hashulchan asher lifne Adonai deitattar (sefer acher deitattad) kame kudesha berich hu. shulchan devar nash, kayyeyma ledakkea leh levar nash, mikkol chovoy. zakkaa ihu, man deillen teren kayymin al patoreh. mille deorayyta. vechulaka lemiskenin, mehahu shulchan.

Kad sallekin hahu patora mikkameh devar nash, teren malachin kaddishin izdammenan tamman, chad mimina, vechad missemala. chad amar da ihu shulchan demalka kaddisha, diflanya ka mesadder kameh, mesaddar yehe tadir patora da, bevirkan ilain, umishcha urevu illaa, kudesha berich hu yishre aloy. vechad amar, da ihu shulchan demalka kaddisha, diflanya ka mesadder kameh, da patora di illae vetattae yevarchun leh, mesaddar yehe hay patora kame attik yomin, behay alma, uvealma deate.

Ribbi abba, kad hava sallekin patora mikameh, hava chafe leh, vahava amar seliku hay patora bitzniu, dela yehe bechissufa kame sheluche malka. shulchan devar nash zache leh lealma deate, vezache leh limzona dehay alma, vezache leh leishtemoda letav kame attik yomin, vezache leh leittosfa chela urevu baatar deitzterich. zakkaa ihu chulakeh dehahu bar nash, behay alma uvealma deate.

Rabbi yaakov amar, ketiv (Shmuel 1 10:11) vayhi kol yodo meitmol shilshom vegomer, hagam shaul banviim. vechi shaul bechir Adonai mikkadmat dena hava, dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 10:11) hareitem asher bachar bo Adonai, asher bocher bo la ketiv, ella asher bachar bo mikkadmat dena. uveshaata deata veal ben nevie veitnabbe benayyhu, amay tavvhu.

Ella, kad kudesha berich hu itree beh, la itree beh ella lemalchu, aval linvua lo. deha teren illen, la itmesaru kachada bevar nash bealma, bar mimmoshe mehemana illaa, dezacha linvua vmalchu kachada, vela ityeyhiv levar nash achara tarvavyyhu kachada.

Vei tema, ha shemuel dezacha letarvavyyeyhu, linvua vmalchu. lav hachi. linvua zacha, dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 3:20) vayyeda kol yisrael middan vead beer shava ki neeman shemuel lenavi. lenavi vela lemelech. navi vedayyayn hava, dei melech hava, la shaalu yisrael melech. aval ihu la hava ella nevia mehemana, vahava dain dinehon deyisrael, dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 7) veshafat et yisrael. veal da kad hava shaul bannevua, tavvhu aleh.

Vei tema, amay shara aleh nevua, hoil vezacha lemalchu. ella tarvavyyhu la zacha behu kachada. (uvegin 0 demalchu yahiv leh kudesha berich hu veode leh ala ad lo have malka) uvegin demalchu ityashav al attearuta deruach kudsha, hava beitaru dinvua kodem lachen. aval kad salik lemalchu, la hava beh nevua, ella ittearu deruach sachletanu, lemedan keshot, ittear aleh, dehachi itchaze lemalka. uveod dehava go innun nevie, shara aleh nevua, levatar deitperash minnayyhu, la hava beh nevua.
Vaana, man yahiv li itaruta deruach kudsha, lemeheve bego nevie mehemne, talmide deribbi shimon ben yochay, deillain vetattain zain minneh, kol shekken ana, lemehve benayychu.
Patach veamar, veasita (Shemot 25:23) shulchan vegomer. shulchan da ihu letatta, leshavvaa aleh lechem deappaya man adif da min da, lechem o shulchan. i tema decholla
806: Ihu chad. ha (sefer acher i tema lechem adif deha) shulchan mitsadra legabbe hahu lechem. vetu, shulchan letatta velechem aleh. lav hachi, ella shulchan ihu ikkara, besiddura dileh, lekabbela birkan dilella umezona lealma. umeraza dehay shulchan, nafik mezona lealma kema deityehiv beh milleella.

Vehahu lechem, ihu ibba umezona deka nafik mehay shulchan leachazaa deha mishulchan da, nafke perin veivin umezona lealma. i la ishtechach kerem, anavin deinnun ibba denafke minneh, la yehon mishtakkechin. i ilana la yehe, ibba la yishtekach bealma, begin kach, shulchan ihu ikkara, mezona denafik minneh, ihu hahu lechem happanim.

Vechahane havo lakte ibba deshulchan meerev shabbat leerev shabbat, (davar acher mishshabbat lashshabbat) leachazaa deha mezona illaa nafik miggo hahu deshulchan. begin hahu lechem dahavo lakte kahani, itbarcha kol mezona umezona deachle veshatan, dela lekatrega behu yetzer hara, deha yetzer hara la ishtechach, ella miggo mechla umishteyya. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 30:9) pen esba vechichashti vegomer, demiggo mechla umishteyya yetzer hara mitrabbe bimoy devar nash.

Lechem da, mezona deka nafik miggo shulchan, mevarech mezona dechahane, dela yishtekach behu mekatrega lekatrega lon, lemiflach belibba shelim lekudesha berich hu. veda itzterich lechahane yattir mikkol alma. uvegin kach, shulchan ihu ikkara, veibba umezona deka nafik minneh, ihu hahu lechem.

Shulchan da, itzterich siddura dileh leittakna, besitra detzafon, dichtiv vehashshulchan titten al tzela tzafon. may tama. begin demittamman sheruta dechedva. semala natil mimina tadir bekadmita, ulevatar ihu ittear legabbe nukeba, uvatar karivat leh yemina legabbeh, veitdabbekat beh.

Mayim innun mimina, veihu chedva, miyyad yahiv lismala, veitdabbaku beh innun mayim, vechaddan leh. uvatar itkelil ihu limina, veittear lenukeba behahu chedva. vesimanach, man denatil mayya bideh yemina bemana, kadmaa learka mayya bismala ihu, vela missemala limina, deha mayya mimina natil lon semala.

Ubbegin kach mayya la ishtechachu, ella missitra dismala. kevan denatilu mayya legabbeh, ha ittearu legabbe nukeba beinnun mayim. veal da gevurot geshamim taninan. uvegin kach vehashshulchan titten al tzela tzafon, demehahu setar ivin ishtechachu beh yattir, missitra ochora. beitaru dechedva dileh bekadmita, kema deat amer (Shir HaShirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi levatar vimino techabbekeni.

Shulchan devar nash itzterich leishtakkecha binkiuta degufa, dela yitkarev lemechal mezona dileh, ella binkiuta degarmeh. veal da itzterich bar nash, lefannaa garmeh bekadmita, ad la yechul mezona deshulchana dachya, dehahu mezona deatkin leh, beh itree kudesha berich hu, begin dela yitkarev al hahu shulchan ki tzoa, deihu meraza desitra achara vesitra achara la yekabbel mehahu mezona deshulchan da kelum.

Levatar deachil bar nash, veitannag, itzterich lemehav chulaka detamtzit lehahu sitra. uman ihu. mayim acharonim. hahu zuhama deyadin, deitzterich lemehav lehahu sitra, chulaka deitzterich leh. veal da vadday innun chova, chova innun, uvaatar dechova sharyayn. veihu chiuva al bar nash, lemehav leh chulaka da. veal da la itzterich levarcha kelal, deha beracha lav ihu behahu sitra.

Uvegin kach itzterich bar nash, dela yahiv mezona deal gabbe patoreh, lehahu ki tzoa, vekol shekken bemeoy, vekol shekken deihu dachyu (tav) levar nash uveriu vetikkuna degufeh. veal da, shulchan ihu lemechal beh bedachyu, kema deittemar.
Shulchan da dekayyeyma beve makdesha, begin leishtakkecha beh mezona, uleappaka minneh mezona, veal da afillu
807: Riga chada, la (136 amud alef) itzterich lekayyeyma berekanayya. shulchan ochora, ihu shulchan derekanayya, vela itzterich lemehav leh ducheta baatar kaddisha. veal da, shulchan demakdesha, afillu riga chada la yativ bela mezona. veyitzterich dela yishtekach atar geria, deha birketa dilella la mishtakkecha baatar geria, da shulchan dekameh dekudesha berich hu. shulchan devar nash deka mevarach aleh lekudesha berich hu, uf hachi la itzterich lemehve berekanayya, deha let birketa baatar rekanayya.

Nahame deal gabbe shulchan dekudesha berich hu, innun teresar. veha okimna raza denahame, deinnun raza depanim. veal da ikre lechem happanim, deha mezona vesippuka dealma, meinnun panim illain kaatyay. uvegin kach, lechem da, ihu penimaa decholla, ihu beraza illaa, kedka yeot.

Lechem happanim, mechla deinnun panim, mezona vesippuka denafik lealma, minnayyhu ate, vesharya al hahu patora, uvegin deshulchan da, mekabbela mezona vesippuka meinnun panim dilella, veihi appikat mezonin vesippukin meinnun panim penimain, umezona deappikat, ihu hahu lechem, kidkamaran, chom hava mitkarev, vechom hava mitade mittamman, veha ukemuha, dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 21:7) beyom hillakcho uvegin shulchan da it levar nash lenatra razin deshulchan dilleh bechol innun gavvnin kidkamaran.

Rabbi elazar patach veamar, (Kohelet 9:8) bechol et yihyu vegadecha levanim veshemen al roshcha al yechsar. hay kera ukemuha veittemar, aval ta chaze, kudesha berich hu bara leh levar nash beraza dechachmeta, veavid leh beumenuta saggi, venafach beappoy nishmeta dechayye, leminda uleistakkela berazin dechachmeta, leminda bikara demareh, kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 43:7) kol hannikra vishmi velichvodi berativ yetzartiv af asitiv. velichvodi berativ dayyka, veraza da velichvodi berativ olifna, deha kavod diltatta raza dechuresyyay kaddisha la (58 58 amud bet) ittakkan leella, ella miggo tikkuna divne alma.

Kad innun bene nasha, zakkain vachasidin, veyade letakkena tikkune, hada hu dichtiv velichvodi berativ. begin dehay chevodi, letakkena leh beamudin takkifin, ulekashta leh betikkuna vekishuta diltatta, begin dehay chevodi yistallak, (bikara) bizchu detzaddikayya di beara.

Begin kach berativ. kegavvna dechavod illaa, detikunin illen beh. (160 veayyen Rosh Chodesh amud alef, 198 amud bet) beria listar semala yetzira bimina kema deat amer yotzer or ubbore choshech asiyya beemtzaita kema deat amer ani Adonai ose kol uchetiv uchetiv ose shalom ubbore ra uchetiv ose shalom bimromav veal da berativ yetzartiv af asittiv ketikkuna ilaa. veal da, hoil veadam ihu beara, veit leh letakkena hahu chevodi avadit beh tikkunin dechavod illaa, deit beh uf hachi beria, veal da berativ.

Behahu kavod illaa, it beh yetzira, veal da yetzartiv, tikkuna da yahavit beh baadam, lemeheve ihu beara, kegavvna dehahu kavod illaa. behahu kavod illaa, it beh asiyyay, veal da uf hachi bevar nash, ketiv asitiv, lemeheve ihu kegavvna dehahu kavod illaa, dimtaken uvarich lichvod tattaa.

Menalan, dehahu kavod illaa it beh telat illen. dichtiv beh, yotzer or uvore choshech ose shalom. yotzer or, ha yetzira. uvore choshech, ha beria. ose shalom ha asiyya. veda ihu kavod illaa, deka metakken uvarich vesappik bechol tzerachav lichvod tattaa.

Kegavvna da, bara adam beara, deihu kegavvna dehahu kavod illaa, letakkena lehay kavod, uleitkalla mikkol sitrin. kavod illaa it beh telat illen, adam letatta it beh telat illen. uleitkalla hahu kavod tattaa, meella umittatta, lemeheve shelim bechol sitrin. zakkaa ihu bar nash, dezache beovadoy lemeheve kegavvna da. veal da ketiv, (Kohelet 9:8) bechol et yihyu vegadecha levanim veshemen al roshcha al yechsar.
Ma lichvod illaa, hahu mishcha revut kudsha la itmanna minneh, meraza dealma deate. uf hachi levar nash, deovadoy mitlabbenan tadir, hahu
808: Meshach revut kudsha, la yitmena minneh tadir.

Bemay zache bar nash, leitadna behahu idduna illaa. beshulchan dileh. kema deihu meaden al patoreh nafshan demiskene, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 58:10) venefesh naana tasbia, ma ketiv batreh, az titannag al Adonai vegomer, deof hachi kudesha berich hu rave leh, bechol innun iddunin dimshach revut kudesha illaa, denagid veitmeshach tadir lehahu kavod illaa, ketiv venefesh naana tasbia, ma ketiv batreh, az titannag al Adonai.

Ribbi yosi veribbi chiyyay hava azle beorcha, vahava chad tayyeya tain avatrayyhu, amar ribbi yosi lera chiyyay, it lan leitasseka uleishtaddela bemille deorayyta, deha kudesha berich hu azil lekamman, (nusach acher deha shechinta azla kamman dichtiv 0 tzedek lefanav yehallech) veal da iddan hu, lemebad leh (nusach acher la) tikkuna bahadan behay archa.

Patach rabbi chiyyay veamar (Tehillim 119:126) et (Bereshit 156 amud bet) laasot laAdonai heferu toratecha, hay kera ittemar, veukemuha chavrayyay. aval et laasot laAdonai, bechol zimna deorayyta mitkayyeyma bealma, uvene nasha mishtadlan bah, kivyachol, kudesha berich hu chadde beovde yedoy, vechadde bealmin kullehu, ushemaya veara kayyme bekiumayyhu. vela od, ella kudesha berich hu kanish kol pamalya dileh, veamar lon, chamu amma kaddisha deit li beara, deorayyti mitattera beginehon. chamu ovde yeday, deatun amartun (Tehillim 8:Adonai) ma enosh ki tizkerennu. veinnun kad chaman chedva demarehon beameh, miyyad patche veamre, (Shmuel 2 7:23) umi cheammecha keyisrael goy echad baaretz.

Uveshaata deyisrael mitbatle meorayyta, kivyachol, tashash cheleh, dichtiv, (Devarim 32:18) tzur yeladcha teshi. ucheden ketiv, (divrei hayamim 2 18:18) vechol tzeva hashshamayim omdim alav, veal da et laasot laAdonai, innun (bene alma) tzaddikayyay deishtaaran, it lon lechagra chartzin, ulemebad ovadin dechashran, begin dekudesha berich hu yittakaf behu betzaddikayyay, umashreyayn veochlosin dileh. may tama. begin deheferu toratecha, vela mishtaddele bah beni alma, kedka yeot.

Hahu tayyeya dehava tain avatrayyhu, amar lon bematu minnayychu, sheelta chada baena leminda. amar rabbi yosi, vadday archa mittakna kamman, shail sheeltach. amar, hay kera, i ketiv yesh laasot, o naase, hava amena hachi. may et. vetu, laasot laAdonai, lifne Adonai itzterich, may laasot laAdonai. amar rabbi yosi, bechamma gavvnin archa mittakna kamman. chad, dahavenan teren, vehashsheta ha anan telata, ushechinta itkelilat bahadan. vechad dachashivna dela havet ella keilana yabbeshta, veant raanana kezeta. vechad, deyeot shaalta, vehoil vesharit milla, ema.

Patach veamar et laasot laAdonai heferu toratecha. et laasot laAdonai, it et. veit et. (Kohelet 3:8) et leehov veet lisno. et ihu leella. dehahu et, raza dimhemnuta ihu. veda ikre et ratzon, vehay ihu deitchayyayv bar nash lemircham laAdonai tadir, kema deat amer (Devarim 6:Adonai) veahavta et Adonai elohecha, veal da, et leehov, da ihu et deitchayyayv bar nash leehov.

Veit et ochora, deihu raza deelohim acherim, veitchayayv bar nash lemisna leh, vela yitmeshach libbeh avatrih, veal da et lisno, uvegin kach ketiv (Vayikra 16:2) dabber el aharon achicha veal yavo vechol et el hakkodesh.

(Vehacha) bezimna deyisrael mishtaddele beorayyta, ufikude orayyta, hahu et raza dimhemnuta kaddisha, mittatkena betikkunaha, umitkashsheta bishlemuta, kedka yeot. uvezimna deyisrael mitbatle meorayyta, kivyachol hahu et, lav ihu betikkunaha, vela ishtechachat bishlimu, vela binhora ucheden et laasot laAdonai.

May laasot. kema deat amer (Bereshit 2:3) asher bara elohim laasot. may laasot. deishtaaru gufe deshede, deitkaddash yoma, vela itavidu, veishtaaru laasot, ruchin bela gufe. uf hacha et laasot, ishtear bela tikkuna, uvela shelimu. may tama. mishshum deheferu toratecha, begin deitbatlu yisrael letatta mippitgame orayyta. begin dehahu et, hachi kayyeyma, o salleka, o nachta, beginehon deyisrael.
809: Chiyyay uneshakuhu beresheh. amar ribbi yosi, vadday let ant keday, letayya avatran. zakkaa archa da, dezachenan lemishma da, zakkaa dara derabbi shimon share begavveh, deafillu bene turaya, chachmeta ishtechachat tamman. nachtu rabbi yosi verabbi chiyyay, veazlu telathon bearcha.

Patach hahu tayya veamar (Tehillim 69:14) vaani tefillati lecha Adonai et ratzon elohim berav chasdecha anini beemet yishecha, tanenan, ematay ikre et ratzon. beshaata detzibbur ka metzalan. shappir ihu, vehachi ihu vadday. deha keden tzibbura mesaddere umetakkeni tikkuna dehay et, ucheden ihu et ratzon, veitzterich lemishal sheelta, dichtiv elohim berav chasdecha aneni beemet yishecha deha keden itzterich lemishal sheelta. vaani tefillati lecha Adonai, ha hacha raza deyichuda.

Vaani: da david malka, (emor 95 amud bet) atar deikre geula. tefillati: da tefilla. vehacha ihu semicha liggeula, deihu chad. kad ihu samich geula litfilla, keden ihu et (205) ratzon. et ratzon: uf hachi, kelala ihu kachada, et chad, ratzon chad, itkelilu da beda, vahavu chad. vedavid malka baa leyachada behay kera, yichuda chada.

Vei tema, amay itmane hay kera, bitzlota demincha deshabbat. yeot ihu lemeheve beshabbat behahu tzelota demincha, vela bitzlota dechol, devadday lav tzelota demincha deshabbat kechol. begin deha bechol beshaata demincha, (88 amud bet) talya dina bealma, velav ihu et ratzon. aval beshabbat, dechol rugeza itade, vecholla itkelil kachada, veaf al gav dedina ittear, itbasmuta ihu, veal da itzterich kera deyichuda, leyachada kol dargin, dechad have yichuda, dina itchabbar veitkelil berachame, veitbassam kolla, ucheden et ratzon ketiv. et ratzon, kalil kolla kachada. vedina itbesam behahu zimna, vahave chedva becholla.

Moshe istallak mealma, behahu shaata ditzlota demincha deshabbat, beshaata deet ratzon ishtechach. uvehahi shaata raava hava leella, vetzaara letatta, veal da ninalu tarin beshabbat, mishaata demincha uleella. man tarin ninalu. tarin deve midrasha, begin leadkera lemoshe raya mehemana, deorayyta itbatla begineh.

Behahu zimna, be midrasha demoshe itbetil, kol shekken acharanin. man chame tarin deve midrasha demoshe deninalu, dela ninalu acharanin kullehu. orayyta demoshe atziva aleh behahu zimna, man la atziv. begin kach kol tare deve midrashe ninalu, veitzterichu kolla letzadka leh lekudesha berich hu beorach shevacha, vehayeynu (Tehillim 36:7) tzidkatcha kehareri el.

Telata innun deistalaku mealma behay zimna, vechullehu kelilan bemoshe. chad, moshe nevia mehemana illaa. vechad, yosef tzaddika. vechad, david malka. begine kach, telat tzidduke dini hacha, chad ihu deyosef zakkaa, kadim lechol hani, veda ihu tzidkatcha keharere el mishpatecha tehom rabba vegomer, da yosef, deihu bilchodoy keharere el, kechullehu turin illain. vechad moshe nevia mehemana, veda ihu dichtiv, (Tehillim 71:19) vetzidkatcha elohim ad marom asher asita gedolot, begin deihu natil lechol sitrin, yemina usemala. vechad ihu david malka, veda ihu dichtiv, (Tehillim 119:142) tzidkatcha tzedek leolam vetoratcha emet, leolam: da david malka.

Keden itkenish kolla behay zimna, tora shebbichtav, vetora shebbeal pe. veal da behay zimna ninalu tare deorayyta, veninalu tare dechol alma, behay zimna. beshaatta demit yosef tzaddika, yavshu mekorin umabbuin, vechullehu shevatin naflu begaluta, patchu illae veamru, tzidkatcha keharere el mishpatecha tehom rabba vegomer. beshaata demit moshe, itchashach shimsha betihara, veanalat tora shebbichtav, nehoraha deaspakalarya denahara. beshaata demit david malka, kenishat sihara nehoraha
810: Veorayyta dival pe kenishat nehoraha. umehahu zimna itgenizu nehorin deorayyta, veasgiu machaloket al mishna, vechakkimayya bemachloket, vechullehu takife libba beirbuveya. veal da, chedva deorayyta lav ihu behahu zimna, bechol darin dealma.

Uma innun chomre detaaniot degazru rabbanan, kad mit peloni, gazru taanit. kad hava kach, gazru kach. (sefer acher da dehava) vechad hava kenishu yattir dechedva detora devichtav vetora dival pe, behahu zimna, al achat kamma vechamma deitzterich leminal tare deorayyta behahu zimna. ubbegin kach amrenan hane tzidduke dina, kema deittemar. chadu rabbi yosi verabbi chiyyay, uneshakuhu beresheh kemilkaddemin, amru zakkaa chulakana behay archa.

Tu patach veamar. (Kohelet 7:19) hachachma taoz lechacham measara shallitim asher hayu bair. hachachma taoz lechacham, da moshe, kad salik letura desinay lekabbela orayyta, izdaazau kol innun rekiin, vechol innun mashshiryayn illain, veamru kameh, marih dealma, uma kol tuva, vechol chedva dilan, lav ihu ella beorayyta, veat bae lenachta lah beara. itkenishu al moshe leokdeh benura, ittakkaf moshe vechulei, kema deukemuha chavrayyay, dekudesha berich hu amar leh lemoshe vechule.

Aval hachachma taoz lechacham, kol man deitassak beorayyta, veishtaddal bah lishmah, ittakkaf bah beorayyta, beshaata deitzterich lemeheve leh tukpa vechela, leaggana aleh beshaata deitzterich. vehahu tukpa vechela mean atar ittakkaf. hadar veamar, measara shallitim. innun (49 amud alef) eser amiran dichtivin bah beorayyta, deinnun shallitin illain, debar nash ittakkaf behu behay alma, uvealma deate kol razin dealma, vechol pikkudin, vechol chachmeta deella vetatta, behu talya, uvehu itkelil kolla, vecholla ihu beorayyta. zakkaa chulekeh man deishtaddal beorayyta, lemeheve mittakaf betukpa lealma deate.

Asara shallitin, eser zine chachmeta innun bah beorayyta, beeser shemahan gelifan, veitkelilu bishma chad, deesrin uteren atvavn gelifin, razin dealma deate, beinnun ziharin, dela shalta ena lemechome, vaafillu besachletanu leminda, uleistakkela behahu idduna, vechissufa, dekudesha berich hu achasin lon letzaddikayyay lealma deate. kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 64:3) ayin la raata elohim zulatcha yaase limchakke lo.

Patora devar nash, mezakke leh lemechal al patora ochora, beidduna dehahu alma, kema deat amer (Shmuel 2 9:13) ki al shulchan hammelech tamid hu ochel. vedavid malka hava amar, (Tehillim 23:5) taaroch lefanay shulchan neged tzorray, veda ihu itsadderuta defatora behahu alma, deha keden ihu idduna vechissufa, denishmeta ithane behu, bealma deate.

Vechi patora it lon lenishmatin behahu alma. in. deha mezona vesippuka deidduna, achle behahu alma, kegavvna demalache illae achle. vechi malache illae achle. in. kegavvna dilhon achlu yisrael bemadbera. vehahu mezona, raza ihu letala, denagid veitmeshach meella, meraza dealma deate, veihu mezona dinhiru meshach revut kudsha, venishmatehon detzaddikayya ittezanu mittamman beginta deeden, veithanun tamman. deha tamman nishmathon detzaddikayya, mitlabbeshan beginta deeden diltatta, kegavvna dehay alma.

Uveshabbate uvizmanne, mitpashshetan, vesallekin lemechome bikara demarehon, uleitaddena beidduna illaa kedka yeot, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 66:23) vehaya midde chodesh bechadsho umidde shabbat beshabbatto yavo kol basar lehishtachavot lefanay amar Adonai. vechi kol basar yete, lav hachi hava leh lemichtav, ella kol ruach o kol neshama, mahu kol basar. ella kudesha berich hu avad leh lebar nash behay alma, kegavvna diykara dechavod illaa leella. hahu kavod illaa, ihu ruach leruach, venishmeta lanshama,
811: Ad demate lechad atar letatta deikre guf, uvehay ayel chad ruach dimkora dechayyim, deikre kol, beda ihu kol tuva, vechol mezona, vechol sippuka, dehahu guf. veraza da, (kahelateh) veyitron eretz bakkol hi (saamaay bechol hi) hay kol ihu ruach lehahu guf.

Kegavvna da bar nash behay alma, ihu guf, veruach deshalta beh, kegavvna dehahu ruach illaa, (sefer acher deshalta al gufa deikre kol) deikre kol, deshalat al gufa leella, veda hu deikre kol basar, veal da ketiv, yavo chol basar lehishtachavot lefanay amar Adonai. al hahu idduna ketiv, (Yeshayahu 64:3) ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha yaase limchakke lo.

Chaddu chavrayyay bearcha. kad matu lego tura chad amar ribbi chiyyay lehahu tayyeya, ma shemecha. amar leh chanan. amar leh kudesha berich hu yechonincha, veyyishma lekolecha beshaata detitztterich leh. amar rabbi yosi, vadday ha nate shimsha, vehachi batar tura da, it kefar chad al shemach, deikre kefar chanan, navit tamman begin yekara dishmach. kad matu lehatam, alu levet ushepizayyhu, vesidru kamayyhu patora, bechamma zinin lemechal. amar ribbi chiyyay, vadday patora da, kegavvna dealma deate, veit lan lesalleka hay patora, uleattera leh bemillin deorayyta.

Patach ribbi yosi veamar, (Devarim 8:10) veachalta veshavata uverachta et Adonai elohecha al haaretz hattova asher natan lach. i beara deyisrael mevarchenan, levar meara menalan. deha begavvna da la itzterich. ella, kudesha berich hu kad bara alma, palig ara, yishuva ihu listar chad, vecharba ihu listar ochora. palig yishuva, veaschar alma sacharaneh dinkuda chada. uman ihu, da ara kaddisha, ara kaddisha emtzaita dealma. uveemtzaita deara kaddisha, ihu yerushala 40. emtzaita diyrushala 40 ihu bet kodesh hakkodashim, vechol tivu vechol mezona dechol yishuva, tamman nachit milleella. velet lecha atar bechol yishuva dela ittezan mittamman.

Palig charba. vela ishtechach charba takkifa bechol alma, bar hahu midbar, detavru (184) cheleh vetukpeh yisrael arbaim shana, kema deat amer (Devarim 8:15) hammolichacha bammidbar haggadol vehannora. behahu madbera, shalta sitra ochora, uvaal karcheh azlu yisrael aleh, vetavru cheleh, arbein shenin. vei yisrael yishtachchu zakkain beinnun arbein shenin, hava mitabbera hahu sitra ochora mealma, umidka argizu leh lekudesha berich hu kol innun zimnin, ittakkaf hahu sitra ochora, venaflu kullehu tamman techot reshuteh.

Vei tema, veha moshe desalik al kol bene alma, hech mit tamman. lav hachi, deha moshe mehemana la hava birshuteh, ella behar haavarim. may haavarim. pelugeta. deitpelagu aleh shalitin illain dilella, vela itmesar bida dimmana veshalita ochora, veishtear hachi, ad deata moshe avda mehemana, veshalit aleh, veitkevar tamman, vela itassak beh bikvurateh, bar kudesha berich hu bilchodoy, dichtiv, (Devarim la) vayikbor oto vaggay.

Vayikbor oto, man. hahu dichtiv beh beorach satim, (Shemot 24:16) veel (vayyar 103 amud bet) moshe amar, vela ketiv man ihu. vayyikra el moshe, vela ketiv man ihu. uf hacha vayikbor oto, vela ketiv man ihu, ella vadday hay atar yedia ihu legabbe chavrayyay. veal da, behahu tura la shallit aleh, bar moshe bilchodoy, veihu itkevar tamman. uvegin leminda lechol darin acharanin dealma, deinnun mete midbar yekumun, hahu raya dilhon ashre leh begavvavyyhu, lemehevi kullehu beitaruta dekiyyuma lealma deate.
Vei tema, i hachi dehahu madbera ihu tukpa desitra ochora, hech pakid kudesha berich hu, al hahu sair, leshaddera leh letura ochora, deikre azazel, hava lon
812: Leshaddera leh lehahu tura deazle yisrael bemadbera beh. ella, kevan deha azlu beh yisrael arbein shenin, ha ittebar tukpeh. vetukpeh ittakkaf baatar dela avar beh gevar tamman lealmin, uvehahu tura, ha hava diyyurehon deyisrael tamman arbein shenin.

Aval behay sair, hahu atar ihu tinara takkifa illaa, utechot amka dehahu tinara, devar nash la (sefer acher lo yachil lemeal tamman) ayil tamman ihu shallit yattir lemechal tarfeh, begin deyitabbar mealayyhu deyisrael, vela yishtekach behu mekatrega alayyhu beyishshuva.

Shuletanuteh deraza dimhemnuta, go emtzaita dinkuda dechol (alma) ara kaddisha, beve kodesh hakkadashim. veaf al gav dehashta lav ihu bekiyyuma, bizchuteh kol alma ittezan, umezona vesippuka mittamman nafka lecholla, bechol atar sitra dishuva. uvegin kach, af al gav deyisrael hasheta levar meara kaddisha, im kol da mechela uzechuta deara, ishtechach mezona vesippuka lechol alma. veal da ketiv (Devarim 8:10) uverachta et Adonai elohecha al haaretz hattova asher natan lach. al haaretz hattova vadday, deha beginah mezona vesippuka ishtechach bealma.

Man deitaddan al patoreh umitannag beinnun mechlin, it leh leadkera uledaaga al kedushsha deara kaddisha, veal hechala demalka deka itchariv. uvegin hahu atzivu deihu ka mitatzav al patoreh, behahu chedva umishteyya detamman, kudesha berich hu chashiv aleh keillu bena beteh, uvana kol innun charbe deve makdesha, zakkaa chulakeh.

Kos shel beracha, la have ella bitlata. begin deha meraza ditlat avahan ka mitbarcha, veal da la itzterich kos ella bitlata. kos shel beracha itzterich lemehav leh bimina uvismala, ulekabbela leh ben tarvavyyhu, begin deityehiv ben yemina usemala. ulevatar yishtevik leh bimina, deha mittamman itbarcha.

Asara devarim neemru bechos shel beracha, vechullehu havo kadka yeot, begin detikkune dechos shel beracha asara innun, veha ukemuha chavrayya. kos shel beracha itzterich leashgacha beh beena, begin dichtiv, (Devarim 11:12) ene Adonai elohecha bah, vela itzterich leitnashe meena, ella leashgacha beh.

Kos shel beracha, itberach behahu bircheta, deka mevarech bar nash aleh lekudesha berich hu, begin (kach) deihu raza dimhemnuta, veitzterich lenatra leh bintiru illaa, keman deihu chashivuta demalka, deha begineh, itberach patoreh, beshaata devirkata mezona, dehahu bar nash mevarech.

Patoreh itzterich dela yehe berekanayya, deha let bircheta mishtakkecha al patora rekanayya, kema deukemuha, dichtiv, (Melachim 2 4:2) haggidi li ma yesh lachy babbayit vegomer. veal da patora la itzterich leitchazaa berekanayya, deha birkan illain la sharyayn, ella baatar shelim. veraza da (Shemot 31:6) uvelev kol chacham lev natatti chachma, uchetiv (daneyalab) yahev chachmeta lechakkimin. veal raza dena shulchan delechem happanim, dichtiv, (Shemot 25:30) venatatta al hashulchan lechem panim lefanay tamid.

Raya mehemna tanain veamorain itkenashu kulchu, deha ka matu shaata, letakkena beh mane malka, (sefer acher leazhara uleittakkana) leanhara leittakna kameh, deinnun: mashkena, menarta, patora, madbecha, kior, vechano, aron, vechapporet, ucheruvim, vecholla beshekel. uvegin da manne leyisrael, ze yittenu.

Kam tana chada veamar, (vadday) raya mehemana vadday hachi hu, velach manne lemebad kullehu, hada hu dichtiv, veasita menora. veasita shulchan. vehachi becholla, uree vaase, umikkolla la itkashe lecha lemebad, ella telat millin dirshimin beatvavn dishmecha, menora, shekalim, hachodesh. amay itkashshe lach.
Amar leh, sava sava, atun mefikin
813: Kusheya da deitkashe li, min miksha tease hammenora. vadday mana dekudesha berich hu, ihi shechinta, deihi mana leshammesha levalah, ihi menarta dileh, deittemar beh, (Tehillim 119:164) sheva bayom hillalticha, deinnun: haggedula, vehaggevura, vehattifert, vehannetzach, vehahod, yesod, umalchut. sheva kelila.

Mishsheva dargin illen, sheloshet kene menora mitzidda haechad, gufa uteren deroe demalka. ihu ner mitzva, leanhara behon. ushelosha kene menora mitzidda hashsheni, innun teren shokin, uverit. veihu ner maaravit, leanhara behon. menarta demalka itkeriat, veihi ner leanhara beh ner mitzva, deittemar beh (Tehillim 19:9) mitzvat Adonai bara meirat enayim.

Uman risha dimnarta, bina Adonai illaa, deit lah telat kanin, bediyyukena da Adonai, telat vavin, deinnun telat avahan. Adonai tannina, 3 kanim tinyaynin bediyyukena da Adonai, (sefer acher telat vavin) deinnun netzach hod yesod. 6 menarta deemtzaita ben yah. al shemeh itkere bina. ihu kalil 6 kanin letatta, bechushevan 6, bev kanin dileh.

10 (Mishlei 12:4) eshet chayil ateret balah, taga desefer tora, ketzurat 7 missitra dealma deate, lav ihi mana legabbeh, velav meshammesha legabbeh, ella atara al resheh. aval bealma den, ihi kegavvna da, 26 ihu mana techoteh, shimmusha dileh, bechol sefira dileh, bechol ever dileh, bechol midda dileh.

Uvegin da, 10 da, lezimnin ihi techotohi, lezimnin al resheh, lezimnin beemtzaita. al resheh Adonai (Tehillim 118:22) even maasu habbonim hayta lerosh pina. veda (Vayikra 24:2) lehaalot ner tamid, deihu 10 al 16 missitra dimnarta. beemtzaita, machatzit hashshekel, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 30:13) ze yittenu, kegavvna da 26. besofa, bemashkena, kegavvna da 26, chamesh ammot orech, missitra de illaa, vaAdonai ammot rochav, missitra de tattaa. veamma: 6. vachatzi haamma: 10. vecholla itremiz beat 6.

Veda ihu raza, (Yeshayahu 45:5) ani rishon vaani acharon umibbaladay en elohim deitremiz behay shema, yod he vav he vechol shem deshallit Adonai al 10 nukeba ihu, missitra dismala. veaf al gav demistera deat 10 ihi berisha, batar devitren hehin ihi besofa, kegavvna da he he, ittedan lerov, venukeba ihi. ella 10 al Adonai (nusach acher 6) taga, techot Adonai, shimmush. kol shekken techot 6.

Uvegin dela avidna kitzutz ufirud beyichuda dilella, decholla yichuda chad, nitkashe li lemebad. (o taga, o emtzai, o shimmusha) vekudesha berich hu deyada kol machashavtin, amar, batar deda letov itkavvavn, dela lemebad kitzutz ufirud, (Shemot 25) tease hamenora, tease meatzmma kegavvna dishchinta, tease meatzmmo dekudesha berich hu, belo piruda. shear manin divhon ihi shechinta shimmush, (Shemot 37:1) vayyaas betzalel.

Uvechol atar dishchinta tattaa ihi attara deammuda deemtzaita, kad nettilat min bina, deihu alma deate, vadday let yedia lebar nash. bekudesha berich hu, vela bechol middot dileh, ad deyeul behay tara, deittemar alah (tehillim 118) ze hashshaar laAdonai.

Beot 30, deihi Adonai (yyy), ihi kelila mikkol sefira, umikkol atvavn dishmahan, meforashim venistarim. ihi nekuda bechol at veat, shimmusha techot balah. veihi atara al resheh, missitra dilah detaame. kegon segol nekuda techot yarche malka, (Yeshayahu 66:1) vehaaretz hadom raglay. veihi beemtzaita, immeh, machatzit hashekel, beshuruk. veihi attara al resheh, missitra desegolta.

Zarka makkaf, shofar holech, segolta, behahu zimna ihi keter al resha demalka, keter yittenu lecha Adonai elohenu. ihi yediat hahu deittemar beh, bamufela mimmach al tidderosh uvimchuse mimmach al tachkor. devah ishtemoda, deihu rishon leella betaga, dehayynu seguleta veihu acharon, besegol. umibbaladav en elohim, beshuruk. vecholla bah ishtemoda. (letatta)
Man deitdabbak bah letatta, ihi mesalleka leh leella. uman devae leistalleka alah leadbeka leella minnah, ihi mashpilatto letatta minnah, velet leh chulaka bah. uvegin deyaakov ishtemoda bah, olif
814: Lah livnoy, umane dela yevakkeshun lesalleka ledarga leella minnah, deihi kolla, ella vetatta veemtzaita. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 49:28) vezot asher dibber lahem avihem.

Navi dehava ishtemoda bah, tzavavch veamar lemare tora chachamim beorayyta, vaatirin bah, usemechim bechelkam. tzavavch legabbayyhu veamar, (Yirmeyahu 9:23) ko amar Adonai al yithallel vegomer, ki im bezot yithallel hammithallel hasekel veyadoa oti. david dehava yada bah amar, (Tehillim 27:3) im tachane alay machan vegomer, bezot ani voteach. veyirmeya chaza galuta arich, vesamael (nusach acher ata) venachash vechol memanan deshivin umin beribbo ribbevavn, denachte al yisrael, vechaza hay kera deamar kudesha berich hu, (Vayikra 26:44) veaf gam zot bihyotam beeretz oyvehem vegomer, amar navi (Eicha 3:21) zot ashiv el libbi al ken ochil. vaasher lo shat libbo gam lazot, aleh ittemar (Tehillim 92:7) uchesil la yavin et zot. (Devarim 33:7) vezot lihuda vayyomar shema Adonai kol yehuda, begin denatir may demane leh avoy zacha lemalchu. vedavid beginah istallak lemalchu, detarach kol yomoy alah.

Amar butzina kaddisha, alah ittemar, (Devarim 4:44) vezot hattora asher sam moshe vegomer. bah azhart leyisrael, bishat mittatcha. bah beracht leyisrael, bechol shevet veshevet. hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 33:1) vezot habberacha asher berach moshe vegomer, uvegin da ukemuha chavrayyay mare matnitin, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 19:14) zot hattora adam ki yamut beohel, veamru alah may ki yamut beohel, ella en hattora mitkayyemet, ella bemi shememit atzmo aleha, velet mita ella oni, deani chashuv kammet.

Deihu karban ole veyyored. missitra deashir ole vadday, deistallak aleh. dechol atirin, kol tivu deavdin, kullehon (sefer acher rubba dilhon) lezakkaa lehon lealma deate, vetamman ihi taga al reshayyhu. benoni, defalach lemizke bitren almin, ihu machatztzit hashekel immeh bealma deate, kegon matztza deitpelig, chetzyah tachat hamappa laafikoman batar seuda. vechetzya lemitzva kodem seuda. umissitra da neemar beester, (Ester Adonai:6) ma sheelatech veyyinaten lach uma bakkashatech ad chatzi hammalchut veteas.

Aval man deihu ani, dememit garmeh beginah, kegavvna dilach raya mehemana, ihu karban yored techotach, vaamay. begin deman deashpil garmeh begin shechinteh, dekudesha berich hu ihu nachit aleh, vehay hu deamar david, (Tehillim 138:6) ki ram Adonai veshafal yire. vehannavi amar, (Yeshayahu 57:15) ki cho amar ram venissa shochen ad vekadosh shemo vegomer veet dakka ushefal ruach. deaf al gav daana marom vekadosh eshkon, begin hahu deitavid dakka ushefal ruach begin shechinati, lesalleka lah mishshifllut dilah attara leresheh, ana nachit ledayyeyra immeh. uvatar devalah dishchinta nachit al bar nash, ihi nechitat meal resheh, veyahivat atra derisha levalah, unechitat leragloy demalka. veraza demilla, (Yeshayahu 66:1) hashshamayim kisi vehaaretz hadom raglay.

Demiyyoma deyarit bar nash nishmeta, kelila mekudesha berich hu ushechinteh, mehahi shaata (91 amud alef) itkere ben. amar chad tana, vechi mehahu yoma deyarit bar nash nishmeta, kelila mekudesha berich hu ushechinteh, yitkere bereh mena lan. mehay kera deamar david besefer tehillim, (Tehillim 2:7) asappera el chok Adonai amar elay beni atta ani hayyom yelidticha.

Amar leh butzina kaddisha, raya mehemana, may hayyom yelidticha. ella beginach amar david beruach kudsha, ani hayyom yelidticha. hen od hayyom gadol, behahu deittemar beh, (Devarim la) vela kam navi od beyisrael kemoshe. ant kayyeymat bishchinta veahavta et Adonai elohecha bechol levavcha, dehayynu gufa. uvechol nafshecha, dehayynu nishmeta. dachamesh shemahan it lah: neshama. ruach. nefesh. chayya. yechida. uvechol meodecha, bechol mamona dilach. kudesha berich hu ushechinteh la yazuz minach bechol illen.

Ant chashavt, deafillu havo kol almin techot reshutach, havet yahiv leakkama lishchinta bekudesha berich hu, uleamlacha leh bishchinte al kol memanan deumin dealma, ulevatar lesalleka leh ushechinteh. bediyyukena dilach kelila mikkol middot tavin, bechol almin, uvemashshiryyayn illain vetattain, veal kol yisrael.
815: Tova hakadosh baruch hu metzarfah lemaase. batar deant bereh, al kol dechashavt lemarach, yekuyyaym al yadach, vela tazuz minneh lealmin, ella tehe bediyyukeneh becholla. veant begaluta ganiz mibbeni nasha. veant mealma da, shelicha dekudesha berich hu lememar millin illen kodamach, vaana metzuve minneh, dela lemezaz minach bechol et veshaata deant bae. ana vechol tanain veamorain dimtivtan. kum ashlim pikkudin demarach.

Patach veamar, veasu (Shemot 25:10) aron atze shittim. sefer tora, ammuda deemtzaita. aron dileh, shechinta. mibbayit umichutz tetzappenu, lekudesha berich hu bishchinte, milvar umilgo (davar acher 33 dileh) vecholla chad. ma delav hachi bearon dehay alma, deorayyta millego min echad, vearon min achara. da bichtivat deyo, veda etz metzuppe zahav. devadday orayyta chaviva mikkolla, hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 28:17) lo yaarchenna zahav uzechuchit.

Umissitra achara afillu behay alma, achze decholla chad, deyo veetz, didyo mitappuchim, deitaviddu beetz innun, (vechol milin daddav etz inun) veod, deyo ucham milvar, vechivvavr millego. hachi innun (nusach acher chachamim mare tora) mare tora vachachamim, uchamim behay alma deihu levar, shefirin behahu alma deate, deihu millego. uvegin da, deyo, lishana dayo leeved lihyot kerabbo. dayo: yod yado, chachma utevuna vadaat dechattav bar nash beyado bidyo. (ad kan raya mehemana) (pinchas 242 amud alef, pikkuda da lehakeriv mincha)

Patach rabbi yosi veamar, beinnun razin illain demashkena ketiv, (Shemot 25:40) uree vaase betavnitam vegomer, uchetiv vahakemota et hammishkan kemishpato vegomer, olifna deamar leh kudesha berich hu lemoshe, kol tikkunin, vechol diukenin demashkena, kol chad vechad kadka chazi leh, dechama leh limtatron, deka meshammesh lechahana rabba lego. vei tema, veha la ittekam mashkena leella, ad yoma deittekam mashkena letatta, vela (143 amud alef) shimesh hahu naar dilella, ad yoma deshimshu letatta, behay mashkena achara.

Ella vadday hachi hu, deha mashkena la ittekam leella, ad deittekam mashkena letatta, aval chama moshe chezu dechol mashkena, vela hava mitsadder bekiyyumeh, ad deittekam mashkena letatta, vechama leh limtatron meshammesh levatar, lav dehava ihu meshamesh, ella dehava meshammesh levatar, velav behahu zimna. amar leh kudesha berich hu lemoshe, chame mashkena, vechame naar, kolla mitakkav ad deyitkam hacha letatta.

Vei tema, i hachi, metatron ihu deka meshammesh. ella vadday mashkena dileh ihu, umichael kahana rabba, ihu deka meshammesh go hahu mashkena dimtatron. kegavvna dimshammesh kahana rabba illaa leella, go mashkena achara setima dela itgalyay, beraza dealma deate. teren mashkenin innun. chad ihu setima illaa. vechad hay mashkena dimtatron. tere kahane innun, chad or kadmaa. vechad michael kahana rabba letatta.
Mikkan razin setimin deve mashkena, mippuma devutzina. mashkena illaa, itbene al teresar margelitin, shayyfin illain, yemina usemala, semala vimina.

816: Bahadeh ikre ihu elohim. vei tema, ha akdim semala beraza dealma deate.

Ha itkelil yemina bismala, venatil semala shema dimina, yemina an kalil begavvih semala, lemehve natil yemina raza dismala. ella, kad itkelil yemina bismala, venatil semala shema raza dimina, yemina kalil begavvih semala, shema el. veihu 55.
