Rabbi chiyyay verabbi yosi havo azle bearcha, ad dahavo azle amar ribbi yosi, niftach beiddunin, (nusach acher baayreyn vabeaydaneyn) venema mille deorayyta. patach ribbi yosi bemille dikriat shema veamar, ketiv (Devarim 6:4) shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad. uchetiv (Devarim 27:9) shema yisrael hayyom hazze nihyiyita leam. uchetiv (Devarim 9:1) shema yisrael atta over hayyom et hayyarden. kol hani shema shema dekaamar moshe amay. deha shema yisrael deyichuda yeot. (dehay lidrasha kaate) hane acharanin amay.

Ella kullehu lidderasha kaatu, shema yisrael deyichuda vadday hay lidderasha ka atya, vehacha ramiz veitchazze yichuda dechachmeta illaa. shema, 70 meatvavn ravrevan ihi, amay. ella remez ka ramiz bichlala chada, leachlela ella vetatta kachada beyichuda chada, (216 amud alef) shema: shem 70. hacha itkelil hay shem beinnun 70 (108 amud alef) shemahan illain, leachlela lon, deha shem itbarcha minnayyhu, veitkelil behu. veitzterich leachlela lon kachada beyichuda chad, uleshavvaa reuteh behu.

Deha vadday 70 shemahan innun beraza dirticha illaa, umehay reticha illaa, itbarcha hay shem, veitkelil begavavyyhu, ulevatar yisrael bichlal. aval ha tanenan, da yisrael sava, lemeheve yisrael bichlala chada, hahu atar devekuta decholla. veal da shema yisrael, hasheta itdavakat itteta bevalah, vahave kolla bichlala chada, veda shema yisrael deyichuda. (yisrael) levatar ka meyached telat sitrin, Adonai elohenu Adonai echad, lemeheve kolla chad.

Shema yisrael dechullehu shear, lav innun kehay gavvna, aval kullehu acharanin lidderasha kaatu, vechullehu beatar achara itdavaku, shema yisrael atta over hayyom. shema yisrael hayyom hazze nihyeta leam. vechullehu bedarga tattaa itdavaku.

Shema yisrael hayyom hazze nihyeta leam, shema yisrael yeot. hayyom hazze nihyeta leam mahu. hayita mibbae leh, may nihyeta. ella bechol atar am, kad itbaru libbayyhu lefulchana, kema deat amer (Daniel 8:27) nihyeti venecholeti. veda hu dichtiv, (divrei hayamim 1 28:2) shemauni achay veammi. i achay, lamma ammi, vei ammi, lamma achay. ella amar david, i biruta attun achay, vei lav attun ammi, letavra libbayychu lefulechani. kach hayyom hazze nihyeta leam, tavart libbecha lefulchana dekudesha berich hu.

Shema yisrael atta over hayyom et hayyarden, kolla bedarga tattaa, ihu, veshama yisrael deyichuda hu darga illaa. ma ben hay lehay. ella hahu shema yisrael deyichuda, la have bechullehu kehay gavvna, deha ihu have raza deella vetatta. (kedka yeot) (nusach acher uvechol atar raza lekabbel vechulei) veihu raza lekabbela alayyhu ol malchut shamayim, bechol sitra, begin deyitzterich leh levar nash, lemeheve zammin (behahu shemma) behahi shaata, leyachada shema dekudesha berich hu, ulekabbela aleh ol malchut shamayim.

Uveshaata deate bar nash lekabbela aleh ol malchut shamayim, keden shechinta atya vesharya al resheh, vekaim aleh kesahid, lesahada sahaduta kame malka kaddisha, dehay ihu deka meyachad shemeh tere zimni beyoma, ushemeh itteyechad ella vetatta kedka yeot. veal da 70 mishma yisrael meatvavn ravrevan, ved name meatvavn ravrevan, lemeheve ed kame malka kaddisha. veha ukemuha, Adonai elohenu Adonai, veda hu raza deyichuda bitlat sitrin, kema deokmeh butzina kaddisha, veittear beh bechamma duchete, velet lan reshu leatara beh yattir.
Vadday hay bar nash, deka meyached shema
819: Dekudesha berich hu ella vetatta kedka yeot, shechinta atya vesharya al resheh, umevarech leh besheva birkan, vekare aleh, (Yeshayahu 49:3) vayyomer li avdi atta yisrael asher becha etpaar.

Rabbi chiyyay patach avatreh veamar, (Devarim 4:35) atta hareta ladaat ki Adonai hu haelohim vegomer, hay kera it leistakkela beh, atta hareta, may hareta. ella kad nafku yisrael mimmitzrayim, la havo yade beraza dimhemnuta dekudesha berich hu kelum, begin dechullehu havo palche pulechana nucheraa begaluta, veanshu kol ikkara dimhemnuta dehava behu bekadmita, deyaritu kol innun teresar shevatin meavuhon yaakov.

Vechad ata moshe, olif lon deit eloah illaa bealma, kema deukemuha. levatar chamu kol innun nissin ugevuran deal yama, vechol nissin ugevuran deavad lehu bemitzrayim. levatar chamu kama gevuran, bemana uvemaya veityehivat lon orayyta, veolifu arche dekudesha berich hu, ad demate leiddana da.

Amar lon moshe, ad hasheta itzterichna lemelaf lechu, kema deyalfin leravyya. (mikkan ulehala) veda hu atta hareta ladaat, veolifat ad hacha, ladaat leminda uleistakkela ulemeal beraza dimhemnuta. umay ihi. ki Adonai hu haelohi 40.

I tema milla zeira hi leminda, ha ketiv veyadata hayyom vahashevota el levavecha ki Adonai hu haelohim bashamayim mimmaal veal haaretz mittachat en od. hacha talya kol raza dimhemnuta, leminda miggo da, raza dechol razin, leminda setimu (nusach acher raza 86) dechol setimin, Adonai elohim shem malle, vecholla chad. atta hareta ladaat, hacha raza derazin leinnun yade middin.

Zakkain innun kol innun demishtaddele beorayyta. uvegin dechad bara kudesha berich hu alma, istakkal bah beorayyta, uvara alma, uveorayyta itbere alma, kema deukemuha, dichtiv, (Mishlei 9) vaehye etzlo amon, al tikre amon ella uman.

Vechi orayyta umana hava. in. lemalka devae lemebad felatrin, i la shavvi legabbeh umana, la yachil lemebad pelatrin. kevan diflatrin itavidu, la salik shema, ella demalka. illen pelatrin deavad malka, malka shavvi beinnun pelatrin machashava.

Kacha kudesha berich hu, bae lemivre alma, istakkal beumana, veaf al gav deumana avad pelatrin, la salik shema ella demalka, illen pelatrin daavad malka, vadday malka bana pelatrin. orayyta tzoochat vaehye etzlo amon, bi bara kudesha berich hu alma, dead (nusach acher ella ad) (sefer acher lo itbere) itbere alma, akdimat orayyta teren alfe shenin lealma, vechad baa kudesha berich hu lemivre alma, hava mistakkol bah beorayyta, bechol milla umilla, veavid lokovlah umanuta dealma. begin dechol millin veovadin dechol almin, beorayyta innun. veal da kudesha berich hu hava mistakkal bah, uvara alma.

Lav deorayyta bara alma, ella kudesha berich hu, beistakkeluta deorayyta bara alma. ishtechach dekudesha berich hu ihu umana, veorayyta lokovleh ulegabbeh umana, shenneemar vaehye etzlo amon, vaehye amon la ketiv, ella etzlo, hoil vekudesha berich hu istakkal bah, etzlo hava umana.

Vei tema man yachil lemehve umana legabbeh. ella istakkeluta dekudesha berich hu begavvna da, (davar acher itavid belo amal vigia dichtiv baddavar Adonai shamayim naasu vegomer. begavvna da beistakkeluta dileh hi umana) beorayyta, ketiv bah, (Bereshit 1:1) bereshit bara elohim et hashshamayim veet haaretz, istakkal behay milla, uvara et hashshamayim. beorayyta ketiv bah, vayyomer elohim yehi or, istakkal behay milla, uvara et haor. vechen bechol milla umilla dichtiv bah beorayyta, istakkal kudesha berich hu, veavid hahi milla, veal da ketiv vaehye etzlo amon. kegavvna da kol alma itbere.
Kevan deitbere alma, kol milla umilla la hava mitkayyem, ad desalik biruta lemivre adam, diheve mishtaddal beorayyta, uveginah itkeyyaym alma. hashsheta
820: Kol man deistakkal bah beorayyta, veishtaddal bah, kivyachol, hu mekayyem kol alma. kudesha berich hu istakkal beorayyta, uvara alma. bar nash mistakkel bah beorayyta umekayem alma. ishtechach deovada vekiyyuma dechol alma, orayyta ihi. begin kach zakkaa ihu bar nash deishtaddal beorayyta, deha ihu mekayyem alma.

Beshaata desalik biruta dekudesha berich hu lemivre adam, kaim kameh bediukenih vekiumeh, kema deihu behay alma. vaafillu kol innun bene alma, ad la yetun behay alma, kullehu kayymin bekiyyumayyhu uvetikunayyhu kegavvna dekayymin behay alma, bechad otzar detamman kol nishmatin dealma mitlabbeshan bediukenayyhu.

Uveshaata dizminin lenachta behay alma, kare kudesha berich hu lechad memana, di manne kudesha berich hu birshuteh kol nishmatin dizminin lenachta lehay alma, veamar leh, zil ayyte li ruach peloni. behahi shaata atya hahi nishmeta, mitlabbesha bediyyukena dehay alma, vehahu memana achze lah kame malka kaddisha.

Kudesha berich hu amar lah, veome lah, dechad techot lehay alma, detishtadal beorayyta leminda leh, uleminda beraza dimhemnuta. dechol man dehave behay alma, vela ishtaddal leminda leh, tav leh dela yitbere. begin kach itchaze kame malka kaddisha, leminda behay alma, uleishtaddela beh bekudesha berich hu, beraza dimhemnuta.

Hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 4:35) atta hareta ladaat, itchaziat al yeda dehahu memana, kame kudesha berich hu. ladaat leminda uleistakkela behay alma, beraza dimhemnuta, beraza deorayyta. vechol man dehava behay alma, vela ishtaddal beorayyta leminda leh, tav leh dela itbere, deha begin da ayyte leh kudesha berich hu levar nash behay alma.

Ladaat ki Adonai hu haelohim. da ihu kelala dechol raza dimhemnuta, (nusach acher kelala) dechol orayyta, kelala deella vetatta, veraza da ihu kelala dechol raza dimhemnuta, vehachi hu vadday. kelala dechol orayyta, da ihu raza detora shebbichtav, veda ihu raza detora shebbeal pe, vecholla chad, kelala deraza dimhemnuta, begin deihu shem malle, deihu raza dimhemnuta, uman ihu. Adonai echad ushemo echad, Adonai echad shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad. da ihu yichuda chad. ushemo echad, baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed, ha yichuda achara lemeheve shemeh chad. veraza da (Melachim 1 18) Adonai hu haelohim, da ketiv, kad innun beyichuda chada.

Vei tema, i hachi, kegavvna dichtiv, (Zecharya 14) Adonai echad ushemo echad, lav ihu Adonai hu haelohim, dei ketiv (nusach acher Adonai hu ushemo echad) Adonai echad ushemo hu echad, hava amena hachi. aval la ketiv, ella Adonai echad, ushemo echad, veitzterich lememar kegavvna da Adonai hu, haelohim hu, veitchazze Adonai echad ushemo echad.

Ella kolla chad, dechad mityaychaddan teren shemahan illen, da beyichuda chad, veda beyichuda chad, keden teren shemahan illen itavidu chad, veitkelilu da beda, vahavi kolla shema shelim, beyichuda chada, uvechen Adonai hu haelohim, deha keden itkelil kolla da beda, lemeheve chad. vead deityachadu kol chad, da bilchodoy, veda bilchodoy, la itkelilu da beda, lemeheve kolla chad.

Kelala dechol orayyta hachi ihu vadday, deha orayyta ihi tora shebbichtav, veihu tora shebbeal pe. tora shebbichtav, da ihu dichtiv Adonai. tora debal pe, da hu dichtiv haelohim. uvegin deorayyta ihu raza dishma kaddisha, ikre hachi tora shebbichtav vetora debal pe, da kelal, veda perat. kelal itzterich lifrat, uferat itzterich likkelal, veityaychadu da beda, lemeheve kolla chad.
Veal da, kelala deorayyta ihu kelala deella vetatta, begin dishma da leella, ushema da letatta, da raza dealma illaa, veda raza dealma tattaa, veal da ketiv, atta hareta ladaat ki Adonai hu
821: Haelohim. da ihu kelala decholla, veda itzterich bar nash leminda behay alma.
Vei tema, pikkude orayyta an innun hacha bichlala da. ella da ihu zachor, veda ihu shamor, vechol pikkude orayyta behane kelilan, beraza dezachor uveraza deshamor, vecholla ihu chad.

Patach rabbi yosi veamar, ha detanenan ditzlota dearvit chova, chova ihi vadday, begin dikriat shema dearvit chova, vekudesha berich hu ityachad belelya, kema deityachad bimama, umiddat lelya itkelil bimama, umiddat yemama itkelil belelya, veitavid yichuda chada. uman deamar reshut, begin emurin ufedarin demitakkele belelya (130 amud alef) veha okimna.

Ketiv (Devarim 6:Adonai) veahavta et Adonai elohecha bechol levavcha uvechol nafshecha vegomer, hay kera okimna leh, veukemuha chavrayyay. aval it leshaala, i behay yichuda dishma yisrael, itkelil kolla, yemina usemala, amay (ketiv) levatar veahavta (Devarim 11) vehaya im shamoa, deha beyichuda itkelilu. aval hatam bichlal, vehacha bifrat, vehachi itzterich.

Uveraza deyichuda da ittearna beh, yichuda da ihu kegavvna ditfillin deresha, utefillin didroa. bitfilin derisha 4 parshiyyayn, veha ittemar, vehacha telat shemahan innun. hatam bitfilin deresha, 4 parshiyyayn, kol chad vechad bilchodoy, vehacha telat shemahan, ma ben hay lehay.

Ella innun 4 parshiyyayn, ha ittearu behu, chad, nekuda kadmaa illaa. vechad, raza dealma deate. vechad, yemina. vechad, semala. illen raza ditfillin deresha. vehacha, beraza deyichuda da, telat shemahan, veinnun kegavvna deinnun 4 parashiyyot. Adonai (9 amud alef) kadmaa, da nekuda illaa, rishita decholla. elohenu raza dealma deate. Adonai batraa, kelala dimina usemala kachada, bichlala chada, veillen innun tefillin derisha, veda ihu yichuda kadmaa.
Tefillin didroa, kelala dechol hane kachada, veda ihu raza baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed. hacha kelala deinnun tefillin deresha, deitkelilu go tefillin didroa.

Veraza da, (135 amud bet) baruch: da raza dinkuda illaa, deihu baruch, dechol birchan navin mittamman. vei tema alma deate ikre baruch. lav hachi, deha nekuda illaa ihu dechar, alma deate nukeba. ihu baruch veihi beracha. baruch dechar. beracha nukeba. veal da baruch ihu nekuda illaa, (Rabbi amud alef) shem: da alma deate, deihu shem gadol, kema deat amer (Yehoshua 7:9) uma taase leshimcha haggadol. kevod: da kavod illaa, deihu yemina usemala.

Vechullehu kelilan behay tefilla shel yad, deihu malchuto, venatil kolla begavveh, uvehay malchuto itteklilan beh almin kullehu, lemezan lon, ulesappeka lon, bechol ma deitzterichu veal da leolam vaed.

Veda ihu yichuda ditfillin derisha, utefillin didroa, uchegavvna deraza deyichuda ditfillin, hachi ihu yichuda decholla, veda ihu berira demilla. veha sadarna yichuda da kame butzina kaddisha, veamar li, deha bed gavvnin itsadar yichuda, veda berira mikkullehu, vehachi ihu vadday, vechullehu raza dimhemnuta, aval siddura ditfillin, da ihu yichuda illaa, kedka yeot.

Umiggo deitkelilu yemina usemala beraza dishma kaddisha beorach kelal, itzterich levatar leappaka lon beorach perat, aval lav beorach yichuda, deha yichuda bikra kadmaa ihu, lemehve Adonai echad bitfilin deresha, ushemo echad bitfilin didroa, vahave kolla chad. kevan deyichuda da itsadar kolla bichlala meresha dinkuda illaa, (sefer acher deihu reshita decholla) itzterich levatar leatara merisha (sefer acher meraza) dinhora kadmaa, deihu risha decholla.

Veahavta da reshita dimina, lemircham leh lekudesha berich hu birchimu deitdabbekuta dileh, uman ihu. (nusach acher rechimu deittear yemina) yemina, deihu ittear rechimu. man derachim leh lekudesha berich hu, ihu ittear yemina dileh legabbeh. umekabbal leh
822: Birchimu. kol millin dealma la talyayn ella biruta, ruach amshich ruach veayyte ruach vesimanach da (Iyov la) im yashim elav libbo rucho venishmato elav yeesof.

Kad atar bar nash rechimu legabbe kudesha berich hu, itaruta dimina la ittear, ella bitlat gavvnin, kema deat amer, (Devarim 6:Adonai) bechol levavcha. uvechol nafshecha. uvechol meodecha. ha telat gavvnin hacha. dela tema o hay o hay, deha la ketiv o bechol levavcha, o bechol nafshecha, o bechol meodecha. ella kullehu itzterich, libba venafsha umamona. ucheden kudesha berich hu ittear yemineh legabbeh, ufashit leh lokovleh, umekabbela leh.

Veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 110:1) neum Adonai ladoni shev limini. veraza dehay kera, ha ittearna beh, dedavid malka al darga dileh kaamar, kad itkashshar bimina. telesar pikkudin hacha bimina, veahavta et Adonai elohecha, ha chada. bechol levavcha, teren. uvechol nafshecha, 3. uvechol meodecha, arba. veshinnantam levanecha, chamishsha. vedibbarta bam, ha shita. beshivtecha bevetecha, ha shiva. uvelechtecha vaderech, temanya. uveshachbecha, ha tisha. uvekumecha, ha asara. ukeshartam leot al yadecha, ha chad sar. vehayu letotafot ben enecha, ha teresar. uchetavtam al mezuzot betecha uvisharecha, ha telesar.

Telesar pikkudin illen, talyayn bimina, usemala itkelil bimina, vehachi itzterich, uvechol zimna dismala itar, yemina share beh beresha. uvegin da, im yizkun, semala itkelil bimina. vei lav, yemina itkelil bismala, veshalta semala. vesimana da, im beresha, kegon (Vayikra 26:3) im bechukotay telchu. uvechol atar, semala ittear birchimu beraza dimina, ulevatar ittakkaf dineh, kema deitzterich. vechach itzterich bechol atar, veha ittearu chavrayyay, behane millin. ata rabbi chiyyay uneshakeh.

Patach veamar (shamevatekav) veet hammishkan taase eser yeriot vegomer, ha hacha raza (139 amud bet) deyichuda, deha tikkuna demashkena mikkamma dargin ihu, dichtiv beh vehaya hammishkan echad. leitchazaa dechol shayyfin degufa, kullehu raza degufa chad.

Bevar nash it beh kama shayyfin illain vetattain, illen penimain lego, veillen beitgalleya levar, vechullehu ikrun gufa chada, veikre bar nash chad, bechibbura chada. uf hachi mashkena, kullehu shayyfin kegavvna dilella, vechad itchabberu kolla kachada, keden ketiv vehaya hammishkan echad. (nusach acher kegavvna deadam)

Pikkude orayyta, kolla shayyfin veevarin, beraza dilella. vechad mitchabberin kullehu kechad, keden kullehu salkan leraza chad. raza demashkena, deihu evarin veshayyfin, kullehu sallekin leraza deadam, kegavvna defikude orayyta, deha pikkude orayyta, kullehu beraza deadam, dechar venukeba, dechad mitchabberan kachada, innun chad, raza deadam. man degara afillu pikkuda chada deorayyta, keillu gara diyyukena dimhemnuta, deha kullehu shayyfin veevarin bediyyukena deadam, uvegin kach kolla salleka beraza deyichuda.
Veal da, yisrael innun goy echad, dichtiv, (Yechezkel la) veatten tzoni tzon mariti adam attem. uchetiv (Shmuel 2 7:23) mi cheammecha keyisrael vegomer.

Rabbi yitzchak hava shechiach kameh derabbi elazar, amar leh, vadday rechimu dekudesha berich hu, devar nash rachim leh, la ittear ella millibba, begin delibba ihu itaruta leitteara legabbeh rechimu, (verachamana lavo bae) i hachi, amay ketiv bechol levavcha, ulevatar uvechol nafshecha. demashma ditren gavvnin innun, chad libba, vechad nafsha, i libba hu ikkara, may bae nafsha. amar leh, vadday libba venafsha teren innun, veitachadan lechad. deha libba venafsha umamona, kullehu itachadan da beda, velibba ihu ikkara visoda decholla.
Veha deittemar bechol levavcha, bitren libban ihu, deinhu teren yitzrin, chad yitzra tava, vechad yitzra bisha, uteren illen kol chad vechad ikre lev, da
823: Ikre lev tov, veda ikre lev ra. uvegin kach ihu levavcha, deinnun teren, yetzer hattov veyetzer hara.

Uvechol nafshecha, uvenafshecha mibbae leh, may uvechol nafshecha, hay bechol amay. ella leachlela 430 220 401, da ihu uvechol nafshecha, bechol ma deachid hay nefesh. uvechol meodecha, uf hachi kama zinin innun demamona, kullehu meshanyayn illen meillen, veal da ketiv bechol. rechimu dekudesha berich hu, lemimsar leh kol da, lemircham leh bechol chad vechad.

Vei tema, beyetzer hara hech yachil bar nash lemircham leh, deha yetzer hara mekatrega ihu, dela yikrav bar nash lefulechana dekudesha berich hu, vehech yerachim leh beh. ella, da ihu pulechana dekudesha berich hu yattir, kad hay yetzer hara itkafya leh, begin rechimu deka mircham leh lekudesha berich hu. dechad hay yetzer hara itkafya, vetavar leh hahu bar nash, da ihu rechimu dekudesha berich hu, begin diydia lekarva lehahu yetzer hara, lefulechana dekudesha berich hu.

Hacha ihu raza lemare midin. kol ma daavad kudesha berich hu ella vetatta, kolla ihu begin leachazaa yekara dileh, vecholla ihu lefulechaneh. vechi man chame avda, delehve mekatrega demareh, uvechol ma diruteh demareh, itavid ihu mekatrega, reuteh dekudesha berich hu, dihon beni nasha tadir befulechaneh, veyehachun beorach keshot, begin lemizke lon bechamma tavin, hoil ureuteh dekudesha berich hu behay, hech atya avda bisha, veishtechach mekatrega miggo reuteh demareh, veaste livne nasha leorach bish, veadche lon meorach tav, veavid lon dela yaavdun reuta demarihon, veaste livne nasha leorach bish.

Ella, vadday reuteh demareh avid. lemalka dehava leh bar yechidai, vahava rachim leh yattir, ufakid aleh birchimu, dela yikrav garmeh leitteta bisha, begin dechol man deyikrav legabbah, lav keday ihu leaala go pelatrin demalka. ode leh hahu bera, lemebad reuteh daavoy birchimu.

Beveta demalka, levar, havat chada zona, yae bechezu, ushefira bereva. leyomin amar malka, beena lemechome reuteh divri legabbay. kara lah lehahi zona, veamar lah zili utefatti livri, lemechome reuteh divri legabbay. hahi zona mai avdat, azlat avatreh divreh demalka sharat lechabbeka leh ulenashsheka leh, ulefatte leh bechamma pittuyin. i hahu bera yeot, veatzit lefikkuda daavoy, gaar bah, vela atzit lah, vedache lah minneh. keden avoy chadde bivreh, veail leh lego pargoda dehechaleh, veyahiv leh mattenan unevizbeza vikkar sagya. man garim kol hay yekar lehay bera, have ema hahi zona.

Vehahi zona it lah shevacha behay o lav. vadday shevacha it lah mikkol sitrin. chad, deavdat pikkuda demalka. vechad, degarmat leh lehahu bera, lechol hahu tivu, lechol hay rechimu demalka legabbeh. veal da ketiv, (Bereshit 1:31) vehinne tov meod. vehinne tov, da malach chayyim. (68 amud bet) meod, da malach hammavet, deihu vadday tov meod, leman deatzit pikkudin demareh. veta chazi, i la yehe hay mekatrega, la yartun tzaddikayya hani ginzeya illain, dizminin leyarta lealma deate.

Zakkain innun deirau behay mekatrega, vezakkain innun dela iarau beh. zakkain innun deirau beh, veishtezivu minneh, divgineh yartin kol innun tavin, vechol innun iddunin, vechol innun kisufin dealma deate, dealeh ketiv (Yeshayahu 64:3) ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha.

Vezakkain innun dela iarau beh, divgineh yartin gehinnam, veitaraddu meeretz hachayyim, deha innun chayyayvayya deirau beh, havo tzayytin leh, veitmashchu avatreh. veal da it letzaddikayya lemechzak leh tavin deha begineh yartin kol innun tavan veiddunin vechissufin lealma deate.
Toalta dehay mekatrega. kad chayyayvayya tzayytin leh
824: May ihi. ella, af al gav delet leh toalta, pikkuda demareh ihu avid. vetu, deha ittakkaf begin hay, hoil veihu ra, ittakkaf kad avid bish. chayyayva la ittakkaf ad dekatil bar nash, kevan dekatil bene nasha, keden ittakkaf veitgabbar becheleh, veit leh nayycha. kach hahu mekatrega, deitkere malach hammavet, la itgabbar becheleh, ad deaste livni nasha, umekatreg lon, vekatil lon, keden it leh nayycha, veittakaf veitgabbar becheleh.

Kema deittakkaf sitra dechayyim, kad bene nasha tavin, veyehechun beorach meshar. uf hachi, hay mekatrega ittakkaf veitgabbar, kad chayyayvayya tzayytin leh, veshalit alayyhu. rachamana lishezvan. vezakkain innun dezakkaan lenatzcha leh, uleachpeya leh, lemizke begineh lealma deate, veittakaf bar nash bemalka kaddisha tadir, al da vadday ittemar, (Tehillim 84:6) ashre adam oz lo vach mesillot bilvavam, zakkain innun behay alma uvealma deate.

Rabbi yosi verabbi yehuda verabbi chiyyay, havo azle bearcha, paga behu ribbi elazar, ad dechamu leh, nachtu min chamare kullehu. amar rabbi elazar, vadday anpe shechinta chamena, deha kad chame bar nash tzaddikayya, o zakkain di bedara, veiara behu, vadday innun anpe shechinta. vaamay ikrun anpe shechinta. begin dishchinta istattarat begavvavyyhu, ihi bistimu, veinnun beitgalleya. begin dishchinta innun dikrivin lah, ikrun panim dilah. uman innun. innun deihi ittaknat bahadayyhu, leitchazaa legabbe malka illaa. vehoil veattun hacha, vadday shechinta ittaknat alayychu, veattun panim dilah. (sefer acher vaaarea behu vadday chame anpe shechinta begin dishchinta istetar begavvayyhu ihi bistimu veinnun beitgalleyay veihi ittaknat bahadayyhu leitchazaa kamme malka vehoil veattun hacha telata vadday shechinta ittaknat alayychu vesharyay bagevaveyykav)

Patach veamar, (Bereshit 33:11) kach na et birchati asher huvat lacha vegomer, kad chama yaakov lesamael, mekatrega behahu lelya, chama leh behahu diyyukena deesav, vela ishtemoda beh ad desalik tzafra. kevan desalik tzafra, veashgach beh, chama leh beanpin setimin veitgalyayn. istakkal behahu diyyukena, dehava kediukena deesav, miyyad ashgach veyada dehava memana deesav. atkif beh ma ketiv, (Bereshit 32:27) vayyomer shallecheni ki ala hashshachar. vechavrayyay ittearu, divgin demata zimneh lezammera uleshabbecha leh lekudesha berich hu, veal da ki ala hashshachar.

Vehacha it leistakkela, devadday shultanuta dileh lav ihu ella belelya, go chashocha, veraza da (Shir HaShirim 3:8) mippachad ballelot da pachda degehinnam. uma deamar ballelot. retzono lomar ihu venukeveh. uvegine kach la shallit ella belelya.

Veda deamar vayyomer shallecheni ki ala hashshachar. may ki ala hashshachar. begin dechad ate tzafra, veitavar shultanu dechashocha delelya, keden al ihu veochluseh benukeba dithoma rabba, delistar tzafon, ad deal lelya, veishteru kalbe, veshalte umeshatte belelya, (davar acher bealma) ad deate tzafra. veal da hava dachik lomar, shallecheni ki ala hashshachar, deha la shallit bimama.

Kegavvna da galuta deyisrael, deihu belelya, veikre layla. malka avodat kochavim umazzalot chayyayva shalta alayyhu deyisrael, ad deyete tzafra veyanhir lon kudesha berich hu, veyitavar shultanehon, veal da ki ala hashshachar, dachik hava bideh, vetashash cheleh, deha itavar lelya veal da ittakkaf yaakov beh, vechama diyyukeneh kediukena deesav, aval la beitgalleya kol kach. ucheden ode leh al birkan.

Ma ketiv levatar, (Bereshit 33:10) ki al ken raiti fanecha kirot pene elohim vattirtzeni. dechama beinnun anpin deesav kediukena deitchaze leh samael mammash, deha bechol atar debar nash itkashshar, hachi itchaze beanpoy. veattun kaddishe elyonin shechinta bahadayychu, veanpin dilchon keinnun anpin dilah, zakkain atun. amar i archa chada havena azle bahadayychu, havena yatve immechon, hashsheta deattun learchayychu, vaana learchi, itperash minnayychu bemille
825: Patach veamar (Tehillim 127:1) shir hammaalot (vayyishlach 172 amud alef) lishlomo im Adonai lo yivne vayit shav amlu vonav bo im Adonai lo yishmar ir shav shakad shomer. vechi shelomo amar tushabbachta da kad bana be makdesha. lav hachi, deha david malka amar leh begin shelomo malka bereh, kad ata natan legabbeh, veamar leh al shelomo deihu yivni be makdesha. ulevatar david malka achze lishlomo bereh diyyukena deve makdesha. kevan dechama david diyyukena deve makdesha, vechol tikkunoy, amar shirata al shelomo bereh, veamar im Adonai lo yivne vayit vegomer.

Davar acher shir hammaalot lishlomo, lemalka dishlama dileh. vehay shirata ihu shirata vetushebachta al kol shear shirata, veshirata hada salleka al kullehu. im Adonai lo yivne vayit, dechama david malka, kol innun ammudin shiva, dehay bayit kaim alayyhu, deinnun kayyme shurin shurin, lemivni hay bayit. leella mekullehu kayyeyma mareh deveta deazil al gabbayyhu, veyahiv lon chela vetukepa, lechol chad vechad kedka yeot.

Veal da amar david, i hay malka dishlama kolla dileh, deihu mareh deveta, la bane lehay beta, shav amlu vonav bo, innun (90 ammudim) kayyaymin dekayymin lemivni al hay beta. im Adonai lo yishmar ir, da malka dishlama kolla dileh. shav shakad shomer, da ihu chad kayyayma dealma ittakkan aleh, umannu. tzaddik, deha ihu natir lah lehay ir.

Mashkena deavad moshe, yehoshua hava kaim tadir venatir leh, deha let netiru dileh bar beh deikre naar, dichtiv, (Shemot 33:11) umesharato yehoshua bin nun naar lo yamish mittoch haohel. levatar hay mashkena la hava natir, ella begin naar achara, dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 3:1) vehannaar shemuel mesharet, (vahava misseder tamman) begin delet netiru demashkena, ella benaar. (aval bi makdesha lav hachi dela netiru dileh ella bekudesha berich hu dichtiv im Adonai lo yishmor ir shav shoked shomer) uman ihu shomer (101 amud alef) da. hahu denatir mashkena deikre hachi naar metatron.

Aval atun kaddishe elyonin, lav netiru dilchon kintiru demashkena, ella netiru dilchon kintiru deve makdesha, kudesha berich hu bilchodoy, dichtiv im Adonai lo yishmar ir shav shakad shomer, deha bechol zimna detzaddikayya azle bearcha, kudesha berich hu natir lon tadir, dichtiv, (Tehillim 121:8) Adonai yishmar tzetcha uvoecha.

Azlu avatreh, veozfuhu telat millin, veahadru learchayyhu karu aleh, (Tehillim 91:11-12) ki malachav (Vayikra 262 amud alef) yetzavve lacha lishmarcha bechol derachecha, al kappayim yissaunecha vegomer. (Mishlei 23:25) yismach avicha veimmecha vetagel yoladtecha.

(Shemot 26:1) veet hammishkan taase eser yeriot vegomer. rabbi yehuda patach, (Mishlei 14:28) berav am haderat melech uveefes leom mechittat razon. berav am haderat melech, illen innun yisrael, dichtiv behu (Devarim 7:6) ki am kadosh atta laAdonai elohecha. veinnun amma desallekin lechamma alfin, ulechama ribbevavn, vechad innun saggiin bechushebanehon, yekara dekudesha berich hu ihu. deha illain vetattain meshabbechan shemeh demalka illaa, umeshabbechan leh begin amma kaddisha da. hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 4:6) rak am chacham venavon haggoy haggadol hazze.

Vei tema, ha ketiv, (Devarim 7:7) ki attem hameat mikkol haammim, ella, mikkol haammim vadday, aval meamma chad yattir saggiin innun. deha let amma bechol alma rav vesaggi keyisrael. vei tema ha bene yishmael, veha bene edom, ha kamma innun. vadday hachi saggiin innun, aval kol shear ammin kullehu mitarve illen beillen, benin it leam da, beam da, uleillen benin beam achara, veillen beachara. ubbegin kach let amma bechol alma, rav saggi keyisrael, amma berira vichidaa, illen beillen, bela irbuveya achara kelal, dichtiv ki am kadosh atta laAdonai elohecha, uvecha bachar Adonai, veal da berav am haderat melech, hiddura ihu demalka illaa kudesha berich hu.
826: Dekudesha berich hu ate leve kenishta, (deihu mak2dash meat) vechol amma atyayn kachada, umetzalan, veodan, umeshabbechan leh lekudesha berich hu, keden hiddura demelech ihu, demelech setam da malka kaddisha. (davar acher meshicha) deittakkan bishfiru uvetikkuna lesalleka leella.

Uveefes leom mechittat razon, vechad ihu akdim leve kenishta, veamma la atyayn letzallaa uleshabbecha leh lekudesha berich hu, keden kol hahu shultanuta dilella, vechol innun memanan umashshiryayn illain, kullehu itbaru (sefer acher itavaru) mehahu illuya demittatkene betikkune hahu melech.

May tama. begin divhahi shaatta, deyisrael letatta ka mesaddere tzelothon uvautehon, umeshabbechan lemalka illaa. kol innun mashshiryayn illain, mesadderin shevachin, umetatkenan behahu tikkuna kaddisha, begin demashshiryayn illain kullehu chaverin innun beyisrael letatta, leshabbecha lekudesha berich hu kachada, lemehve silluka dekudesha berich hu ella vetatta kachada.

Vechad innun mizdammenan lemeheve chaverim behu beyisrael, veyisrael letatta la atyayn lesaddera tzelothon uvautehon uleshabbecha lemarehon, kullehu mashshiryayn kaddishin, shultanuta illaa itbaru (itavaru) mittikkunehon, deha la sallekin besiluka, vela yachlin leshabbecha lemarehon kedka yeot. begin dishvache dekudesha berich hu, itzterich lemehve kachada ella vetatta, illain vetattain beshaatta chada, veal da mechittat razon vela mechittat melech.

Vaafillu dela asgiu beve kenishta, ella asara, beinnun asara mizdamnan mashshiryayn illain, lemehve immehon chaverim. may tama begin dechol tikkune dehahu melech, innun baasara, veal da day baasara, i lav innun yattir.

Veta chaze bamishkan ma ketiv, (Shemot 26:1) veet hammishkan taase eser yeriot, eser: begin detikkuna demashkena, (nusach acher dishchinta) baasara ihu, lemeheve kedka yeot. eser, may tama eser, vela asara. ella eser, bechol atar ihu bela shechinta, delav ihi bechushebana kegavvna da (Melachim 1 7:25) omed al shene asar bakar, shechinta lav ihi bechushebana, deha ihi kayyeyma leella, dichtiv, (Melachim 1 7:25) vehayyam alehem milmala. uveillen duchete dirmize leraza dilella dechaser minnehon, (sefer acher Adonai) ha shechinta yattir al hahu chushebana, delav ihi bechushebana.

Lesitra achara, yahave chushebana yattir, veihi beminyayna bigriu, (davar acher lo tema chushebana yattir ella tosefet et vechushebana bigriu) kegon ashte, veha ukemuha. uvechol atar deatvavn ittosfan, kegavvna da, ihu liggeriuta. kegon (Shmuel 2 13:20) haaminon achich, desagya amnon. uvesitra dikdusha, gara at veihu tosefet.

Rabbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Tehillim 104:2-3) ote or kassalma note shamayim kayria. hay kera ukemuha, dechad bara kudesha berich hu alma, (pinchas 245 amud bet) itataf behahu or kadmaa, uvara beh shamayim.

Veta chaze, or vechoshech (davar acher lav) kachada havo. or missitra dimina, vechoshech missitra dismala. may avad kudesha berich hu, shittef lon kachada, uvara minhon shamayim. may shamayim. esh umayim. shitfan kachada, veavid shelam benayyhu.

Vechad itkelilu kachada, umatach lon, kayria matach lon, veavid minhon at 6 veda ikre yeria. yeriot, deha at da itpashit minneh nehiru, veitavidu yeriot, hada hu dichtiv veet hammishkan taase eser yeriot.

Vesheva rekiin innun metichin, genizin bignizu illaa, kema deukemuha. vechad rekia dekayyeyma alayyhu, vehahu rakia let beh gon, velet leh atar beitgalleya vela kayyayma leistakkela beh, (sefer acher ella besucheltanu) vehay rakia ihu ganiz, venahir lechullehu, venatil lon bematlanehon, kol chad vechad kadka chazi leh. ella kayyayma besucheltanu.
Mehay rakia ulehala, let man deyeda veyishgach, veit leh levar nash lemistam pumeh, udela lemallela uleistakkela besucheltanu. man deyistakkal ahdar laachora, delet man deyachil leminda.
Eser yeriot innun, deinnun asara rekiin. uman innun yeriot demashkena deinnun eser. vekayyman leminda lechakkime libba. man deyinda behu, istachal bechachmeta sagya, uverazin dealma, veistakkal
827: Leella behahu atar, dechol chad vechad itdabbak beh, bar teren innun dekayyman bimina uvismala, veinnun genizin bahade shechinta.

Rabbi yosi amar tesha rekiin innun, ushechinta ihi ashiraa. dei tema begin dichtiv eser, bar mishshechinta ihu. i hachi, shechinta chad sare ihi dekayyeyma al eser. ella vadday tesha innun, veinnun tesha yomin sheben rosh hashshana leyom hakkippurim, veihi ashiraa. kegavvna da, mishkan ihu eser yeriot.

Innun eser rekiin raza derazin dela itmesar bar leinnun deyade chachmeta, vecholla ihu berazin devutzina kaddisha, deihu galle raza dechol rekia urekia, veinnun shammashin dimshamshe bechol chad vechad. sheva rekiin innun leella, sheva rekiin innun letatta, kegavvna dilella. sheva rekiin innun, debhu kochavaya umazzale leanhaga alma da kefum archeh, kema deitzterich leh.

Bechullehu sheviaa adif, bar teminaa, deka madbar lechullehu, vekayyeyma al kullehu. ketiv (Tehillim 68:5) sollu larochev baaravot, man rochev baaravot, uman innun aravot. ella, aravot da rekia sheviaa, amay itkere aravot. al deihu kalil meeshsha umaya kachada, umissitra dedarom, umissitra detzafon, veihu meurav mitteren sitrin.

Vei tema, i hachi, shete aravot deka mitchabberan belulav, vetanenan aravot, hada hu dichtiv sollu larochev baaravot. i hachi, man yahiv yarkin begufa, o gufa beyarkin, deha da avid perin veevin, veda (169 amud bet) la avid perin veevin.

Ella, vadday kolla hu raza daaravot devalulav, innun aravot devalulav, chad esh, vechad mayim. beraza da dechullehu, veihu sheviaa ihu esh umayim kalil kachada, beraza chada, uvegin daaravot ihu raza kelala dechullehu shit acharanin, ihu raza dirticha illaa, vekudesha berich hu itree behay rekia, yattir mekullehu rekiin, vetiuveteh tadir leatkena lehahu rekia, bishfiru illaa. veal da, sollu larochev baaravot lehahu derochev baaravot. uman ihu. hahu rakia tamir veganiz, dekayyeyma al gabbe chevata, deihu rochev baaravot.

Veilzu (170 amud bet) lefanav. millefanav la ketiv, ella lefanav, deha let man deyinda beh kelum. aval lefanav, man deayil lekameh dehay rekia, itzterich lemeal bechedva, vela baatzivu kelal, begin dehay rekia garim, detamman la sharya atzivu verugeza kelal, deha tamman kolla ihu bechedva.

Veal da, kohen gadol dekayyeyma lekameh, la hava al leve kudesha, bar bechedva, uleachazaa chedva, deha atra garim. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 100:2) ivdu et Adonai besimcha bou lefanav birnana. deha itzterich dela leachazaa bah atzivu.

Vei tema, i hachi, hay man deihu betzaara uvedochka, dela yachil lemechde libbeh, umiggo dochakeh it leh lemitba rachamin, kame malka illaa, i hachi, la yitzle tzelota kelal, vela yiyiul baatzivu kelal, deha la yachil lemechode libbeh, uleaala kameh bechedva, may tikkuna it leh lehay bar nash.

Ella vadday ha tanenan, kol tarin ninalu veasgiru, vetarin didmain la asgiru, velet dima ella miggo tzaara veatzivu. vechol innun dimmanan al innun tarin, kullehu metabberin gezzizin umanulin, veayylin innun dimin, vehahi tzelota alat kame malka kaddisha.

Keden hahu atar it leh dochaka, mehahu atzivu vedochaka dehahu bar nash, kema deat amer (yeshaya 63) bechol tzaratam lo tzar. tiuveteh dehahu alma illaa, legabbe hay atar, kidchura detiuvete tadir legabbah denukeba. kad malka al legabbe matronita, ashkach lah baatzivu, keden kol ma deihi baat, bidaha itmesar, vehahu bar nash, vehahi tzelota, la ahdar berekanayya, vekudesha berich hu chayyis
828: Aleh. zakkaa chulakeh dehahu bar nash, deoshid dimin kame kudesha berich hu, bitzloteh.

Kegavvna da beshabbat, man deyativ betaanita beshabbat, miggo tzareh achze atziva, uveshabbat shalta hahu rekia illaa, hahu deitchaze bechedva, veihu chedva vechadde lecholla. hahu deyativ baatzivu, begin deihu shalta, appik lehahu bar nash mehahu onsha deitgezar aleh, veha ittemar, sollu: havu yekar, verommu lehahu derochev baaravot, deihu chedva vechadde kolla, rekia al gabbe chevata beyah shemo vadday, deha behahu atar shema da itkelil. veilzu lefanav, begin dela itzterich leachazaa kameh atzivu, kema deittemar.

Rabbi elazar amar, hay kera, hachi itzterich lememar, sollu larochev al aravot, may baaravot. beyah shemo, beyah hu mibbae leh, may shemo. ella hay kera, al setima dechol setimin, attika dechol attikin ittemar. hahu dela itgalya, vela ityeda kelal, deihu rochev baaravot. vei tema, deihu atya verachiv beh, i hachi, af al gav desatim hu beatar da kayyeyma leitgalya.

Ella sollu larochev baaravot, da ihu attika dechol attikin, setima dechol setimin, dela yedia. uvamme ihu rochev, baaravot, beyah, deihu raza kadmaa denafik kammeh (davar acher minneh) veda ihu shemeh, mehahu setima, dela yedia, shema (Vayikra 29) dileh hu yah. lav deihu hu, ella ihu hu, begin dehahu parochta (Vayikra 128) deitparsa venafik mikkameh. aval hay parochta ihu shemo, veda ihu reticha dileh, vela ityeda kelal.

Veda ihu shemo haggadol, begin deit shemeh delav ihu kol kach gadol, kehay af al gav deit beh tosefet atvavn. da ihu shema rabba, veal da behay shema, anan mefikin amen, deihu minneh. behay azla amen bechol zimna, uvishma achara lav hachi.

Amen yehe shemeh rabba mevarach, dechad hay shema ittakkan, kolla ihu bishlimu, vechol almin chaddan bechidu. behay shema, kelilan illain vetattain. behay shema, kelilan shit mea utelesar pikkude orayyta, deinnun kelala dechol razin illain vetattain. kelala dealma didchura leella, uchelala dealma denukeba letatta.

Vechullehu pikkudin, kullehu shayyfin veevarin, leitchazaa behu raza dimhemnuta. man dela yashgach vela istakkal berazin defikude orayyta, la yeda, vela istachal, hech metatkenan shayyfin beraza illaa. shayyfin degufa kullehu, mittakkenan al raza defikude orayyta, veaf al gav deit shayyfin, deinnun ravrevin veillain, kullehu zeirin veravrevin, i itnetil chad minnayyhu, afillu zeira devar nash, ikre mareh demuma, kol shekken vekol shekken hahu degara afillu chad pikkuda meinnun pikkude orayyta, deatil muma beatar dela itzterich.

Ta chazi, ma ketiv, (Bereshit 2:15) vayyikkach Adonai elohim et haadam vayyannichehu vegan eden leavdah uleshamrah. vetanenan, leavdah uleshamrah illen karbanin, vecholla chad. aval da raza defikude orayyta, leavdah: illen 248 shayyfin illain. uleshamrah: illen telat mea veshittin vechamesh shayyfin tattain. illen illain dezachor. veillen tattain deshamor, vecholla chad.

Zakkaa ihu man dezache leashlama lon. pikkudin deorayyta, garim levar nash leashlama rucheh venishmateh behay alma, uvealma deate. orayyta mezakka levar nash, leachsena teren almin, alma da vealma deate. kol man deishtaddal beorayyta, ishtedal bachayyim. chayyim behay alma, vechayyim bealma deate. ishteziv mikkol onashin bishin, dela yachlin leshalletaa aleh. i beishtaddeluta hachi. kol shekken man deavid ovada.
Rabbi chiyyay veribbi abba, sharu beve ushepizayyhu, kamu befalgut lelya,
829: Leishtaddela beorayyta. berateh deushefiza, kamat veanhirat lon sharga, ulevatar kayyeymat avatrayyhu lemishma millin deorayyta.

Patach rabbi yosi veamar, (Mishlei 6:23) ki ner mitzva vetora or vederech chayyim tochchot musar. ki nir mitzva, kol man deishtaddal behay alma, beinnun pikkudin deorayyta, itsadar kameh bechol pikkuda ufikkuda chad sharga, leanhara leh behahu alma. vetora or, man deitassak beorayyta, zache lehahu nehora illaa, deadlikat sharga minneh, deha sharga bela nehora la kelum. nehora bela sharga, uf hachi la yachil leanhara. ishtechach decholla da leda itzterich. itzterich ovada leatkena sharga. veitzterich lemile beorayyta, leanhara sharga. zakkaa ihu man deitassak bah binhora uvesharga.

Vederecha chayyim tochchot musar, orach chayyim leaala beh lealma deate, innun tochachot, dimkabbel bar nash leaadaa garmeh meorach bish, ulemehach bearcha tava. tu vederech chayyim, innun tochchot musar, deayyte kudesha berich hu aleh devar nash, ledakkea leh mechovoy beinnun tochachot. zakkaa ihu man dekabbil lehu biru delibba.

Davar acher ki ner mitzva, (tikkuna dishraga) da sharga butzina dedavid, deihu nir mitzva orayyta dival pe, deitzterich leittakna tadir, veihi la nahara ella miggo tora shebbichtav, deha orayyta dival pe let lah nehiru, ella miggo tora shebbichtav, deihi or leanhara.

Ashgach avatreh, vechama berateh deushepiza kayyeyma avatrayyhu, amar ki ner mitzva, may ner. da ner deihi mitzva denashin zachyayn beh, veihi nir deshabbat, deaf al gav denashin la zakkan beorayyta, ha guverin zachyayn beorayyta, venaharin lehay sharga, denashin metatkenan behay mitzva. nashin betikkuna dehay ner. guverin beorayyta, leanhara lehay ner, tikkuna demitzva denashin itchayyvu behu.

Shamat hahi itteta uvachat, addehachi kam avuha deitteta, dahavat tamman, veal benayyhu, vechama berateh kayyeymat avatrayyhu uvachat, shail lah avuha. sachat leh (rabbi abba) ovada. shaari avuha deitteta uf ihu uvacha. amar leh rabbi yosi, dilma chatanach balah dibberatich, la zacha beorayyta. amar leh vadday hachi hu, veal da vadday bachinan, ana uverati tadir.

Uvegin dachamena, leh yoma chad, dedallig meigra da, lemishma kaddish bahade tzibbura, salik biruta dili, lemehav leh berati, vetechef denafku tzibbura mibbe kenishta, yahivna leh berati. daamena bediluga da deata lemishma kaddish, gavra rabba lihave beorayyta, veaf al gav deihu ravya, vela yedana beh mikkadmat dena. vehasheta afillu birkat mezona la yada, vela yachilna bahadeh lemile ben chavrayyay, deyolif keriat shema, o birkat mezona.

Amar leh abar leh beachara, o dilma bera yolid delihve gavra rabba. addehachi kam ihu, vedileg alayyhu veyativ lekamayyhu. istakkal beh rabbi yosi, amar, vadday ana chamena behay ravya, dinhora deorayyta yippuk lealma minneh. o bera deyokim minneh. chayyicha hahu ravya, veamar, rabbotay ema kamayychu chad milla.

Patach veamar (Iyov 32:6) tzair ani leyamim veattem yeshishim al ken zachalti vaira mechavot dei etchem. hay kera ittearu beh ammude alma. aval elihu dichtiv beh mimishpachat ram, itaro, deha mizzara deavraham kaata. veshappir. aval elihu kahana hava, umizzara diychezkel nevia hava, ketiv hacha ven barachel habbuzi, uchetiv hatam (Yechezkel 1:3) yechezkel ben buzi hakkohen.
Vei tema begin dichtiv buzi, (Iyov 31:34) buz mishpechot hava. lav hachi, hadar veamar mimishpachat ram, illaa al kolla. amay ikre buzi. al demevaze garmeh legabbe man
830: Degadol minneh, veal da salik bishma illaa, buzi, da deikre adam shelema becholla, ma dela ikre hachi bar nash achara, hada hu dichtiv, (Yechezkel 2) veatta ven adam, veal desalik bishma da, ikre ram, illaa al kolla.

Veal da amar tzair ani leyamim. leyamim, miyamim mibbae leh, may leyamim. ella amar tzair ani, veazirna garmay leyamim, legabbe bar nash deit leh yomin saggiin. may tama. begin deamarti deyamim yedabberu, veal da tzair ani, veazirna garme legabbe yamim. veattem yeshishim, chamena lechu yeshishim. al ken zachalti vaira mechavot dei etchem. uf ana, amarti yamim yedabberu verav shanim yodiu chachma. vadday. achen ruach hi veenosh venishmat shadday tevinem. veal da begin daana ravya, shavena biruti dela lemallela ad teren yarchin, vead yoma da ishtelimu. vehasheta deattun hacha, it lemiftach beorayyta kamayychu.

Patach veamar, (Mishlei 6:23) ki ner mitzva vetora or vederech chayyim tochchot musar. ki ner mitzva da ihi mishna, kema deat amer (Shemot 24) vehattora vehammitzva. vehattora: zo tora shebbichtav. vehammitzva: zo mishna. deihi nir sharga, dekayyeyma leadleka.

Ner amay ikre ner. ella kad mekabbela mevin teren deroin, 248 shayyfin illain, ihu patchat legabbayyhu teren deroin dilah, keden itkelilu illen teren deroin behu, veikre nir. vetora or, deka nahir lehahu ner veadlikat minneh missitra deor kadmaa, deihu yemina. deha orayyta mehahu sitra dimina deor kadmaa ityehivat, dichtiv, (Devarim 33) mimino esh dat lamo, missitra dimina ityehivat, (44 amud alef) af al gav deitkelil beh semala, deha keden ihu shelimu decholla.

Or da itkelil bematan veshiva almin, deinnun genizin besitra dehahu or, veitpashshat bechullehu. techot kuresyay illaa temira, sharyayn innun olamot, missitra dehahu yemina. telat mea vaesher innun, matan vesheva, innun besitra dimina. mea utelat, innun besitra dismala. veinnun telat mea vaesher. veillen innun dekudesha berich hu metakken tadir letzaddikayya, umeillen mitpashshetan kama vechamma otzre chemda, vechullehu genizin leitadna minhon tzaddikayya lealma deate veal illen ketiv (Mishlei 8:21) lehannechil ohavay yesh veotzrotehem amalle veal illen ketiv (Yeshayahu 64:3) ayin la raata elohim zulatcha vegomer.

310: Illen, telat mea vaesher olamot, genizin techot alma deate, (veal) innun matan vesheva deinnun missitra dimina, ikrun or kadmaa. begin deafillu or semala ikre or. aval or kadmaa ihu zamin lemebad toladin lealma deate. vei tema lealma deate vela yattir. ella afillu bechol yoma veyoma dei la hava hay or, alma la yachil lemekam, dichtiv, (Tehillim 89:3) amarti olam chesed yibban.

Hay or zara leh kudesha berich hu beginta deiddanoy, veavid leh shurin shurin, al yedoy dehay tzaddik, deihu gannana deginta, venatil lehay or, vezara leh zerua dikshot. veavid leh shurin shurin beginta veolid veatzmach veavid perin, uminnayyhu ittezan alma, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 97:11) or zarua latztzaddik vegomer.

Uchetiv (Yeshayahu 61:11) ucheganna zerueha tatzmiach. man zerueha. illen zerue deor kadmaa, deihu zarua tadir, hasheta olid veavid evin, vehasheta zarua ihu, bekadmita, ad la yechul alma ibba da, olid zerua da veyahiv ibba vela shachich. veal da, kol almin ittezanu besippuka dehahu gannana, deikre tzaddik, dela shachich vela pasik lealmin.

Bar bezimna deyisrael begaluta. vei tema bezimna degaluta ketiv, (Iyov 14:11) azlu mayim minni yam venahar yechorav veyavesh, hech avid toladin. ella ketiv zarua, zarua ihu tadir, umiyyoma deafsik hahu nahar. beginta (sefer acher beginta) la al
831: Beh hahu gannana. vehahu or deihu zarua tadir, avid evin uminneh umiggarmeh izdera kekadmita, vela shachich tadir. keginta deavid toladin, umehahu zarua nafil beh beatreh, umiggarmeh avid toladin kedivkadmeta. vei tema, deinnun toladin veevin havo kema dehava bezimna deganana tamman. lav hachi. aval la itmanna zarua da lealmin.
Kegavvna da vetora or, orayyta deityehivat missitra dehahu or kadmaa, hachi izdera tadir bealma, veavid toladin veevin, vela shachich lealmin, umehahu ibba dileh ittezan alma.

Vedercha chayyim tochchot musar. teren archin innun, chad orach chayyim, vechad behippucha minneh. simana deorach chayyim man ihu. tochchot musar. dechad baa kudesha berich hu lenatra lehay orach chayyim, shavve aleh hahu dealke, veavid tochchot musar livne alma. uman ihu. hay dichtiv, (Bereshit 3:24) veet lahat hacherev hammithappechet lishmor et derech etz hachayyim veal da, derech chayyim ihu tochchot musar. uman deit beh tochachot, vadday demitare leh lemehach behahu orach chayyim, deshari tamman tochchot musar.

Hay kera lav resheh sefeh velav sefeh resheh. ella kolla raza dimhemnuta dehay kera. ki ner mitzva, da raza deshamor. vetora or, da raza dezachor, vederech chayyim tochchot musar, illen gizrin veonashin deorayyta, vecholla raza dimhemnuta. veitzterich da leda, ulemeheve raza decholla kadka yeot.

Veal raza da dehay or, dedalik venahir lehay nir, ketiv beh beaharon, (Bamidbar 8:2) behaalotcha et hannerot, begin dehu ate missitra dehay or. or da ketiv beh, (Bereshit 1:3) yehi or vayhi or. kevan deamar yehi or, amay ketiv vayhi or, deha bevayhi chen sagya. ella, yehi or, da or kadmaa, deihu yemina, veihu leketz hayyamin. vayhi or, demimina nafik semala, umeraza dimina nafik semala, veal da vayhi or, da semala.

Mikkan devayhi kadmaa deorayyta, besitra dismala hava. uvegin kach lav ihu siman beracha. may tama. begin deveh (nusach acher deminneh) nafak hahu choshech deachashich anpe alma. vesimana da kad itgele raza deesav veovadoy, behay vayhi hava, dichtiv (Bereshit 25:27) vayhi esav ish yodea tzayid. itkayyaym bevayhi ish yodea tzayid, lefattaa bene alma, dela yahachun beorach meshar.

Vayyar elohim et haor ki tov, da ihu ammuda dekaim beemtzaita, vekaim veachid besitra da, uvesitra da. kad hava shelimu ditlat sitrin, ketiv beh ki tov, ma dela hava behane acharanin, begin dela hava shelimu ad or telitaa, deashlim lechol sitrin, vechevan deata telitaa da, keden afrish machaloket dimina usemala, dichtiv vayyavdel elohim ben haor uven hachoshech.

Veal deinnun chamesh dargin, deitperashu veitmeshachu mehay or kadmaa, ketiv (491 280 amud alef) or chamesh zimnin, vechullehu havo missitra dimina, veitkelilu beh, vechad itkelilu bistar semala, itkelilu beraza demayim, denatil bimina (sefer acher 151) uvegin kach ketiv mayim chamesh zimnin. vechad ishtelimu beraza deemtzaita, ketiv rakia chamesh zimnin, veal da telat innun or. mayim. rekia. lokovel telat dargin illen, dechullehu chamesh dargin itkelilu behu, veal da bechullehu ketiv chamesh zimnin, bechol chad vechad.

Hacha raza derazin, beillen telata, ittzayyayr veitgelif begillufe raza diyyukena deadam, deihu or bekadmita, levatar mayim, levatar itpashat begavvavyyhu rakia, deihu gelifa digllifu diyyukena deadam.

Kegavvna digllifu tziyyura dediyyukena deadam betuledateh. deha betuledata devar nash, bekadmita zera, deihu or, deha nehiru dechol shayyfe gufa, ihu hahu zera, uvegin kach ihu or, vehahu or ikre zera, dichtiv or zarua, hahu zera mammash. levatar hahu zera deihu or itpashat veitavid
832: Mayim, belachuta dileh, aglif yattir, veitpashshat peshitu go innun mayim, peshitu degufa lechol sitrin. kevan deittzayyayr, veiggelif tziyyura udeyukena degufa, akrish hahu peshitu, veikre rakia. veda ihu rakia betoch hammayim. ulevatar deakrish, ketiv vayyikra elohim larakia shamayim. deha akrish hahu lachuta (davar acher deingid veishtaar hahu pesolet) degufa, dehava go innun mayim.

Kevan deivrir gufa, veinake binkiu, hahu lachuta deitnegid veishtear, hava pesolet deka itavad go hittucha, veinnun mayim haraim achurin, uminnehon itavid pesolet, mekatrega lechol alma, dechar venukeba. levatar kad nachtu innun mayim achurin, veithattechu letatta bistar semala, nafku (sefer acher daatanegayd veishtaar itavid pesolet mekatrega lechol alma dechar venukeba veinnun mayim haraim achurin. levatar kad nachtu inun mayim achurin atehatekav letatta bistar semala unefaku) lekatrega kol alma. zakkaa ihu man deishteziv minnehon.

Kevan denafik mekatrega, ketiv yehi meorot chaser 6 veitmashshecha askara beravye, vechaser nehora desihara. levatar vehayu limorot, bishlimu tarvavyyhu kachada. beman. behahu rekia hashshamayim, deha kad salleka veitchabbera behahu rekia hashshamayim, keden vehayu limorot, nehorin shelemin tarvavyyhu kachada dela pegime kelal.

Shari chayyicha hay ravya vechadde. amar lon hay daamena deitberir hacha raza deadam, beor dehahu (davar acher deihu) zera, ulevatar itavid mayim, umiggo innun mayim, itpashat rakia, diyyukena deadam kema deittearna. tinach kad itavid da lego meoy deitteta, deha la ittzayyayr zara, ella bego meoy denukeba, leitpashta bah diyyukena deadam, vehacha i illen chamesh dargin, innun diyyukena deadam, bean atar ittzayyayr veitpashshat hay diyyukena, bego innun mayim.

I tema go nukeba havo, da alma deate, lav hachi, deha la ittzayyayr tziyyura udeyukena, ad denafku atvavn levar, ulevatar itgelimu. vetu deha alma deate hava umana, dichtiv vayyomer elohim yehi or vayhi or. vayyomer elohim yehi rakia, ha umana hava.

I tema benukeba diltatta, lav hachi, deha ad la havavt, vechad nafak hay diyyukena deadam, nukeveh nafkat bahadeh. ha la ittzayyayr diyyukena deadam bah. i hachi, bean atar ittzayyayr veitgelif hay zera, lemehve gelifu diyyukena deadam.
Ella da raza illaa, adam kadmaa ittzayyayr veitgelif bela nukeba. adam tinyayna, mechela vezara dehay, aglif veittzayyayr go nukeba.

Adam kadmaa, gelifu detziyyura udeyukena degufa, la hava benukeba, uvela tziyyura kelal hava. veittzayayr veiggelif letatta mealma deate, bela dechura, uvela nukeba, innun atvavn aglimu go mishchata, veittzayayr veiggelif behu raza deadam. veatvavn beorach meshar, besiddura dilhon, meraza deor kadmaa, shariu leitgalfa uleittzayyeyra, (atvavn) veizdera hay or begavveh go mishchata. kad mata go mishchata, ithaddar mayya, go mayya, itpashat rakia tziyyura deadam, diyyukena kadka chazi.

Levatar deitkashshetat nukeba legabbeh, veithadderu anpin beanpin, hay diyyukena deadam, al betiuveta legabbe nukeba, vetamman aglif veittzayayr kegavvna dileh, vealeh ketiv (Bereshit Adonai:3) vayyoled bidmuto ketzalmo vegomer, hay ittzayyayr go nukeba, ma dela hava hahu kadmaa, deittzayyayr (davar acher 33 go) hahu kadmaa begavveh bimdidu go mishchata kema deittemar.

Kegavvna da letatta. letatta ma ketiv, (Bereshit 4:1) vehaadam yada et chavva ishto vattahar vatteled et kayin, shariat kof leolada, bimaha, bechela vesiua (231 amud alef) deadam levatar deha kabbilat (148 amud bet) zuhama miggo hay kof. veal da la ketiv hacha vayyoled, ella yada vattahar vatteled, venafak pesolet go nukeba.
Vattosef laledet et achiv et havel, uvehay name la ketiv vayyoled, veaf al gav demistera didchura hava. aval mekatrega tashash vetavar cheleh, deha beat kof shariu
833: Kevan deitberir pesolet, shariu atvavn leolada meraza deat 700. tikkuna dechar venukeba. beistakkemuta kachada. ucheden ketiv vayyoled bidmuto ketzalmo vayyikra et shemo shet, vela ketiv vattikra. vayyikra ihu, vela ihi. ihu kara shemeh shet, tikkuna dechar venukeba kachada, dahavo beistakkemuta chada.

Tu itgalgalu atvavn, veahadru leolada alef deadam, veinnun atvavn baatar deihu siyyum shemeh. uman ihu. 50, ulevatar 6 la Adonai, deha itadiat (nusach acher ateyylaydat) behevel. begin kach natil at achara avatreh 6, siyyem besheruta deshet 300, veikre enosh.

Enosh ma ben shema da lishma deadam. ella enosh lav ihu betukpa hava, tikkuna dekadmae hava, (Tehillim 8:Adonai) ma enosh ki tizkerennu. uchetiv (Iyov 7:18) ma enosh ki tegadlenno vegomer, vattifkedennu livkarim lirgaim tivchannnu. veal da ketiv (Yeshayahu 53:10) vaAdonai chafetz dakkeo hecheli, teviru degufa, vetukpa denafsha, orit shet leenosh yeruta dehava leh lekabbela. veihu uf hachi orit livno.

Tu itgalgalu atvavn leatkena akima, veithadderu leolada. kenan. hay tikkuna dekayin, veittakkan techoteh, veithadderu atvavn levassema alma meakimu dehava. mahalalel 40 sofa deatvavn deadam. Adonai 36 tikkuna deatvavn dehevel, uvegin dela hava chayyayva kekayin, la itchallafu atvavn mishshemeh bar chad. divaatar 2 hava 1 lemeheve tikkuna yattir.

Ad hacha itbesam alma, veittakkan akima meshsheruta deenosh. bar chova deadam, dela itbesam, ad dekayymu yisrael betura desinay, aval tikkuna deakimu dekayin vehevel ittakkan veitbasam, aval alma hava betzaara veitzvona, ad deata noach dichtiv, (Bereshit Adonai:29) ze yenachamenu mimmaasenu umeitztzevon yadenu min haadama asher arerah Adonai. vechova deadam la itbesam, ad dekayymu yisrael al tura desinay, vekabbilu orayyta, vechad yisrael kabbilu orayyta, keden ner veor ittakkan kachada.

Vehasheta rabbotay, ana mibbavel, uvera derav safra ana, vela zachena leishtemoda leabba, veatridna hacha, vedachilna, deha yatve ara da, innun aryeyvavn beorayyta, veshavena alay dela ema mille deorayyta kame bar nash, ad teren yarchin, veyoma da ishtelimu. zakkaa chulaki deitaretun hacha. arim rabbi yosi kaleh uvache, vekamu kullehu uneshakuhu beresheh. amar rabbi yosi zakkaa chulakana dezachena behay archa, lemishma mille deattik yomin mippumach, ma dela zachenan lemishma ad hasheta.

Yativu kullehu, amar lon rabbotay, middechamena tzaara dehay chami uverateh, dedachake umitztaare benafshayyhu, dela yedana birkat mezona. amena lon, dead deenda birkat mezona, la itchabbar beinteti, keorach kol bene alma, veaf al gav deyachilna leshammesha bah bela chova, la beena lemebar al datayyhu, hoil vela havena yachil lememar midi, ad teren yarchin. chadu rabbi yosi verabbi chiyyay vechamoy uverateh, uvachu misgiu chedva. amar rabbi yosi, bematu minach, kevan dishriat, anhir lan yemama, zakkaa chulakana beorach da.

Patach hahu ravya bevirkat mezona veamar, katuv echad omer (Devarim 14:23) veachalta lifni Adonai elohecha, vechatuv echad omer (Devarim 27:7) vesamachta lifne Adonai elohecha. hane kerae kad yisrael havo sharan beara kaddisha, veitchazun kamme kudesha berich hu beve makdesha, havo mitkayyeymme. hashsheta hech mitkayyeymme, man yachil lemechal lifne Adonai ulemechede lifne Adonai.

Ella vadday hachi hu, bekadmita kad yativ bar nash al patoreh lemechal, mevarech al nahama hammotzi. may taama hammotzi, vela motzi, deha ketiv (Yeshayahu 42:5) bore hashshamayim, vela ketiv habbore. (Yirmeyahu 10:12) ose eretz, vela ketiv haose eretz. may taama hacha hammotzi.
Ella kol millin deinnun meraza dealma illaa setira, istattera Adonai mittamman, leitchazaa deha mealma geniza usetira ihu.
834: Vechol millin deinnun mealma tattaa deitgalya yattir, ketiv baAdonai, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 40:26) hammotzi bemispar tzevaam (Amos Adonai:8) hakkore leme hayyam, kullehu meraza dealma tattaa ihu, vei (231 amud bet) achtiv bishma ihu baAdonai, kegon hael haggadol, vehacha deihu beorach satim (nusach acher beitgalleya) meraza dealma tattaa ihu, kevan dimvarech bar nash, shechinta atya kameh.

Uma deamar veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha. hacha itkelil lemallela bemille deorayyta, dehachi itzterich hoil vekudesha berich hu kameh, lekayyeyma dichtiv, (Yechezkel 41:22) ze hashshulchan asher lifne Adonai. uchetiv (Devarim 14:26) veachalta sham lifne Adonai elohecha.

Hoil vekaim bar nash kame mareh, itzterich name lemechan lemiskene, lemetan lon, kema deihu yahiv leh lemechal. (sefer acher uman deachil kammeh malka kaddisha itzterich vechulei) keman deachil kame malka kaddisha veitzterich dela yishtechach balan al patoreh, deha bilanu missitra achara have, veraza da (Bereshit 25:30) haleiteni na, orach balanu, vehachi itzterich lesitra achara, uchetiv (Mishlei 13:25) uveten reshaim techsar. veal da veachalta lifni Adonai elohecha ketiv, vela lifne sitra achara. veitzterich dela yitassek bemillin betelin, uvetzarche seuda (shappir) veitzterich leitasseka bemillin deorayyta, deha kad millin deorayyta ittemaru al patora, yahiv hahu bar nash tukpa lemareh.

Vesamachta lifni Adonai elohecha, da ihu bechos shel beracha, kad barich bar nash bechos shel beracha, itzterich lemechode uleachazaa chedva vela atzivu kelal, kevan denatil bar nash kos shel beracha, kudesha berich hu kaim al gabbeh, veihu itzterich leatafa resheh bechedva. ulevarcha al hakkos bemotav telata, nevarech sheachalnu mishelo.

Uvetuvo chayyinu, da itzterich reuta leella legabbe attika deattikin, veal da ihi beorach satim. uvetuvo, vela mittuvo, uvetuvo: da yemina (davar acher zaynah) illaa. umittuvo: da darga achara, deate missitra dimina, veihu darga letatta minneh, begin divhahu tov itbeni alma, uveh ittezan.

Amay ikre tov vaamay ikre chesed. tov ihu, kad kalil kolla begavveh, vela itpashat lenachta letatta. chesed kad nachta letatta. veavid tivu bechol biryayn, betzaddike uverashie vela chayish, veaf al gav dedarga chad hu. menalan dichtiv, (Tehillim 23:6) ach tov vechesed yirdefuni, i tov lamma chesed, vei chesed lamma tov, deha bechad sagya ella tov kalil kolla begavveh, vela itpashat letatta. chesed nachit (109 amud alef) veitpashshat letatta, vezan kolla tzaddike verashie kachada.

Vehacha kevan deamar uvetuvo chayyinu, hadar veamar hazzan et haolam kullo betuvo bechesed, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 136:25) noten lechem lechol basar ki leolam chasdo. veal da hazzan et hakkol, letztzadike ulerashie lecholla. da ikre birkat yamin. semol lav ihu bevirkat mezona. uvegin kach semala la tesayyea limina.

Dechevan devarich birkat yamin (nusach acher hayyayin), itzterich ledabbeka eretz hachayyim bayyamin, leittezana mittamman, ulefarnasa ulemehav mezona lecholla, veal da tinyayna birkat haaretz, veitzterich leadkera bah berit vetora, al beritcha shechatamta bivsarenu, veal toratcha shelimadtanu, leachazaa demehahu tov ittezan berit vetora, deihu tikkuna dehay tov.

Mikkan olifna, denashim peturot mibbirkat mezona leappaka yede chova, deha let behu tora uverit. velachatom al haaretz veal hammazon, ha didvekuta kachada bechesed, al haaretz da ihi eretz hachayyim. veal hammazon da ihu chesed, ha kelilu da beda bidvekuta chada.

Itpashshetuta detov ihu hodaa deikre chesed, veal da ihu omer, node lecha, al kach veal kach nissin veatin deitaviddu missitra detov. vei tema veha ketiv (Tehillim 16:11) neimot bimincha, netzach, ha ihu missitra deyamin. lav hachi, ella kol chad vechad achze al hahu atar denafik minneh.
Vei tema netzach bayyamin, ha ketiv neimot, uchetiv (Shmuel 2 23:1) uneim zemirot yisrael, (Bereshit 21 amud bet) (davar acher bimincha netzach) veda semala.
835: Vechol semala itkelil beraza dimina. aval hodaa ode al yemina, leachazaa deha minneh nafka, veda peshitu detov, deitpashshat beeretz hachayyim.

May tama let hacha semala, begin delet chulaka lesitra achara bimzona deyisrael. vei ittear semala, sitra achara yittear immeh, veha ihu zabbin becheruteh vechulakeh leyaakov avuna. (Vayikra 21 amud alef) veha anan yahivna leh chulakeh, lehahu mekatrega bezuhama demayin batrain, vei let zuhama, ha chulakeh dehahu mechla, dekarivu beh yedin.

Veal da let leh chulaka bahadan. vehoil velet leh chulaka bahadan, deha natal chulakeh, let lan leitteara semala kelal. dela yittear mekatrega veyittol teren chulakin, chad letatta, vechad leella, kabbechor. deha zabbin becheruteh leyaakov avuna. chulakeh ihu letatta, velet leh leella kelum. yisrael natle leella, veesav natil letatta, veal da la yitkerav semala kelal, bevirkat mezona.

Kevan demitbarcha hay eretz hachayyim missitra dimina, umekabbel mezona, keden baenan rachamin al kolla. rachem Adonai elohenu al yisrael amach veal yerushalayim irach vegomer, deha mehahu mezona vesippuka deeretz hachayyim, nizke bah anan uve makdesha. deyitbene be makdesha letatta beinnun rachamim.

Uveshabbat dela ishtechach dina, lemeheve netzach vehod kelal chasadim, omer retze vehachalitzenu lemeheve (vaychi 219 amud alef) tarvayyhu, (Yeshayahu 55:3) chasde david hanneemanim, veal da al tehi tzara veyagon vechulei, deha retze umodim, innun chasde david, vesim shalom dekaamaran bitzlota, bevirkat ose shalom bimromav hu berachamav yaase shalom alenu.

Hattov vehammetiv, decholla ate missitra dimina, vela mistar semala kelum. man dimvarech birkat mezona, ihu natil birchan bekadmita mekullehu, veitberach bichlal birkat mezona, veal da it leh arka dechayyin. man denatil kos shel beracha, veka mevarech aleh, ketiv (Tehillim 116:13) kos (Bereshit 1 amud alef, 223 amud alef) yeshuot esa. man yeshuot da yemina, deihu moshia mikkol mekatregin dealma, dichtiv (nusach acher hoshia lo yemino) vattosha lo yemino, uchetiv (Tehillim 60:7) hoshia yemincha vaaneni.

Adhachi hava nahir yemama, kamu kullehu uneshakuhu. amar ribbi yosi, vadday hilula ihu yoma da, vela nefuk mehacha, ad deyitavid hilula bechol anshe mata, da hu hilula dekudesha berich hu itree beh. natlu lah leinteteh, uvarichu lah bechamma birchan, avdu daavuha yetakken beta achara lechedva, kenishu kol anshe mata lehahi chedvata, vekaru lah kalla. vechaddu immehon kol hahu yoma, veihu chadde immehon bemille deorayyta.

Patach ihu al patora veamar, (shamevatekav) veasita et hakkerashim lammishkan atze shittim omdim. ketiv hacha omdim. uchetiv hatam (Yeshayahu 6:2) serafim omdim. ma lehallan serafim, uf hacha name serafim. illen kerashim kayyman betikkune dechalla, vesacharan sacharana dechuppa, lemishre behahi chuppa ruach illaa, (nusach acher raza illaa) kegavvna da kalla letatta, itzterich letakkena chuppa lechufaa betikino shafiru, likara dechalla achara, deatya lemishre tamman bechedva, lechalla tattaa.

Uvegin yekara dehahi kalla illaa, itzterich lemebad chuppaa dishpiru, bechol tikkune dishpiru, lezimna lechalla illaa, lehahi chedva. kegavvna da bechol geziru divrit letatta, itzterich leatkena kisse achara bishfiru, (hakedama 13 amud alef) lemare kina divrit kayyayma deate tamman. uf hacha bechol chuppa, itzterich tikkune shefiru, lechufaa lechuppa likara dechalla setam.

Deha da, kegavvna deda kayyeyma. da salleka besheva birchan, veda salleka besheva birchan. vechad salleka besheva birchan keden ikre kalla. veal da asir leshammesha bah ad deitkelilat beinnun sheva birchan, kegavvna illaa.
Innun sheva birchan, yarta kalla, merucha (nusach acher meraza) illaa,
836: Atar dechol birchan nagdin mittamman. shit birchan innun dechalla itbarcha minnayyhu, veat amart deinnun sheva. ella sheviaa ihu deka mekayyem kolla.

Rubba devirkaan al hayyayin amay. ella deihu sitra dechadde lecholla, al hahu yayin deitnetir baanavoy tadir. uvegin kach beracha kadmaa deinnun sheva, ihu raza deyayin, yayin avid peri (sefer acher chedu) ben leella ben letatta. gefen natil kolla, veappik ibba lealma, veattearu dechedva semala ihu, dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi ulevatar vimino techabbekeni. vehahu ilana dechayye avid perin veevin (sefer acher behahu gefen) beitaruta da, veda ihi beracha kadmaa decholla. (bore peri haggefen).

Tinyayna shehakkol bara lichvodo, raza divrit kaddisha, chedva dechibbura, denatil kol birchan meraza dimina, lemebad evin behahu gefen, deha bekadmita hahu peri (nusach acher chedu) nachit milleella, orach shayyfin, venagid livrit kaddisha, lenagda leh behahu gefen, veda missitra dimina, deha let ibba mishtachcha ella bimina. semala itar vimina avid.
Levatar kalil semala bimina, vimina bismala, lemehve raza deadam. uvegin kach telitaa ihu yotzer haadam. veal da yaakov, deihu ammuda deemtzaita, diyyukena deadam hava.

Reviaa, ihu ammuda chada, deyarka yemina. chamishaa, sos tasis vetagel akara deveta, bechedva bekibbutz uchenishu divnaha, mearba sitre alma, veda raza deyarka achara, deitchabbar beyarcha semala, lemezal ulemichnash lechol sitrin, uchenishu divnin, urechimu, lemeal lon ben birkin.

Uveinnun teren, dinviim sharyayn begavvavyyhu, chedva deikara deveta. may tama. begin deha shete aravot, la avdin eva uferin, uchenishu divnin legabbayyhu, innun perin veevin dilhon, vela attearu kenishu divnaha legabbaha, bar banviim.

Shetitaa sameach tesammach reim haahuvim, atar diruta vechedva veachva ishtechach, ammuda dechol alma deikre tzaddik, vetzaddik vetzedek reim vaahuvim innun, dela itadun da min da. ad hacha shit birchan, dechalla itbarchat minnayyhu.

Sheviaa ihu mekayyem kolla, umehay sheviaa mitbarchan kolla vadday, kelala deeser amiran, begin deda, kalil ella vetatta. veal da kalil behay, 10 zine dechedva, sason, simcha, chatan, (sefer acher vechala, gila, ditza, ahava, veachuha, 376) vechalla, ahava, achva, gila, rinna ditza, chedva, shalom vereut, lemehve kalla shelimu decholla.

Zakkain innun yisrael, deinnun zachu letatta, kegavvna dilella. alayyhu ketiv, (Shmuel 2 7:23) umi cheammecha keyisrael goy echad baaretz. chadu kullehu kol hahu yoma bemillin deorayyta, vechol bene mata avdu leh resha alayyhu. leyoma achara, kamu rabbi yosi verabbi chiyyay uvarchu lon, veazlu learchayyhu.

Kad matu legabbeh derabbi shimon, zakaf enoy vechama lon. amar lon mistakkel havena bechu yoma da, vachamena lechu teren yomin vechad lelya, dahaveton legabbe mashkena dehahu naar metatron, vehahu naar hava olif lechu razin illain bechedva deorayyta, zakkaa chulakechon banay.

Sidderu millin kullehu kameh, vesachu leh ovada, amar lon zakkain attun, vezakkaa chulaki, deha adkarna yoma chad dehava azil immi bearcha rav safra avoy, uvarichit leh kad itperash minni, diyyhe leh bar arya beorayyta, vela barichit leh deihu yizke beh. zakkaa chulakechon banay, alayychu ketiv (Yeshayahu 54:13) vechol banayich limmude Adonai.

Davar acher vechol banayich limmude Adonai. vechi kol benin deinnun deyisrael, kullehu olif lon kudesha berich hu orayyta. in. deha beshaata deinnun yanuke laan beorayyta, shechinta atya veyahiv lon chela vetukpa lemile beorayyta, deilmale siyyua dekudesha berich hu, la yachlin innun yanuke lemisbal.

Rabbi shimon hava shechiach yoma chad gabbe pitcha delud, verabbi chiyyay bahadeh, paga beh chad yanuka, amar rabbi shimon vadday dekudesha berich hu itree (nusach acher ittear) bealma hasheta leyomin zeirin, gilgula rabba lemalche ara illen beillen.
837: Vadday beod deinnun mekatregin illen al illen, yisrael yehon go revavcha.

Amar hahu yanuka, veha beyoma da shaari ittearuta da, deha behay yoma damin saggiin oshdin bealma. amar leh rabbi chiyyay, mena leh lehay yanuka. amar rabbi shimon, lezimnin nevua nafil befum yanukan, umitnabbee yattir mechad nevia.

Amar hahu yanuka, vechi tavavha ihu beyanuke lemeheve lon nevua, veha kera shelim ihu. menalan. dichtiv vechol banayich limmude Adonai. innun vadday limmude Adonai, unevua minnehon nafka, ma delet hachi lechol alma, ella leyisrael bilchodoy, dichtiv behu vechol banayich limmude Adonai, uvegine kach minnehon nafka nevua. ata rabbi shimon uneshakeh amar miumai la shemana da, bar hasheta.

Da pikkuda dekudesha berich hu lemoshe: (Shemot 26:15) veasita et hakkerashim lammishkan atze shittim omdim. (kolla kegavvna illaa) (davar acher 33 patach rabbi yitzchak) uchetiv (Yeshayahu 6:2) serafim omdim mimmaal lo shesh kenafayim vegomer, ovada demashkena beinnun kerashim, kegavvna deinnun serafim, (behay atar) illen omdim, veillen omdim.

Vei tema, veha kol chayyayle shemaya innun omdim kullehu, kema deat amer (Zecharya 3:7) venatatti lecha mahlechim ben haomdim haelle, uchetiv (Melachim 1 22:19) vechol tzeva hashshamayim omdim alav vegomer, deha kullehu mashshiryayn illain let lehu kefitzin, vechullehu kayyme bekima. ella vadday kullehu kayymin, ulezimnin illen ikrun serafim, ulezimnin sallekin bishma achara, aval illen kullehu bechad shema kayyme.

Vehay kera ukemuha, (nusach acher rabbi yitzchak patach) ketiv (Tehillim 23:1) mizmor ledavid Adonai roi la echsar. ha (50 amud alef) ittemar, ma ben mizmor ledavid, uven ledavid mizmor. vehacha, shechinta kadma veatya, vesharat aleh bekadmita. Adonai roi, vechi ammay shechinta kadma hacha, veha david itzterich leakdema (sefer acher leitteara) ihu bekadmita, hoil uvae mezoneh meim kudesha berich hu.

Ella, vadday shechinta kadma veatya, vesharat aleh, veatarat leh leshabbecha lemalka shevacha da, ulemibbae mezoni mikkame malka, deha hachi itzterich al milla dimzona devaya ihi ureuta dilah, dechol bene alma yivun mezone. begin dechad kudesha berich hu bae lenachta mezone lealma, ihi natla bekadmita, veala nachte mezoni lealmin kullehu. uvegine kach ihi akdimat lemilla da dimzone, vesharat aleh dedavid.

Adonai roi, Adonai raya dili, kehay raya demadbar ana dileh beatar diddeshain vaasavin, dela michsar beh kol middeam. uf hachi kudesha berich hu, hu ihu raya dili, lemezan li bechol ma daana itzterich. davar acher Adonai roi, tanenan, dekashin mezonotav debar nash kame kudesha berich hu, kikriat yam suf. hacha teren gavvnin innun, vetarvavyyhu beorach keshot.

Chad begin dekudesha berich hu kol ovadoy bedina ukeshot, veal dina ukeshot itkayyaym kol alma. uvechol yoma veyoma, uvechol zimna vezimna, dan kol alma bedina letztzadike velirshie ulechol bene alma, kema deat amer (Tehillim 11:7) ki tzaddik Adonai tzedakot ahev. vechad ihu dan beni nasha, vechame beni nasha kama chayyayvin, vechamma chatain kameh, keden keshe beenoy lemehav lon mezona bechol zimna, begin deit leh lemezan chayyayvayya, uleinnun dechatan.

Veihu avid immehon lego mishshurat haddin, vezan umefarnes lon kefum chesed illaa, deitmeshach (168 amud bet) veitnegid al kol (sefer acher ammin uvene) beni alma, uveh ihu zan umefarnes lecholla, letztzadike ulechasidde velirshie, ulechol innun bene alma, ulechol chevan uveire chakla, veofe shemaya, mikkarne reemim ad betze kelame, vela ishtear bealma, deihu la zan umefarnes lecholla, af al gav dikshe kammeh, lefum ovadin divni alma, kikriat yam suf.
Vechi keriat yam suf keshe kammeh, vehachtiv (Nachum 1:4) goer bayyam vayabbeshehu, (Amos Adonai:8) hakkore leme hayyam vayishpechem al peni haaretz, veha kevan desalik
838: Reuta kammeh, kolla kameh keayin hu chashiv, veat amart dikriat yam suf keshe kammeh.

Ella bezimna deyisrael abaru legabbe yamma, uvaa kudesha berich hu lemikra lon yamma desuf, ata rahav hahu memana deal mitzrayim, uvaa dina mikkame kudesha berich hu. amar kammeh, mareh dealma, amay att bae lemebad dina al mitzrayim, ulemikra yamma leyisrael, ha kullehu chayyayvin kammach, vechol archach bedina ukeshot. illen palche kochavim umazzalot veillen palche kochavim umazzalot. illen begiluy arayot, veillen begiluy arayot. illen oshde damin, veillen oshde damin.

Behahi shaata hava keshe kammeh, lemebar al orach dina. veha yisrael havo natle al yamma, dichtiv, (Shemot 14:15) vayyomer Adonai el moshe ma titzak elay dabber el beni yisrael veyyisau, vahava keshe kammeh lemebar al dina, ulemikra lon yamma desuf, veilmale deashgach kudesha berich hu bizchut avraham, deakdim betzafra lemebad pikkuda demareh, ureuta dileh, kedichtiv (Bereshit 22:3) vayyashkem avraham babboker, kullehu itavidu beyamma, begin divchol hahu lelya, bedina hava kudesha berich hu alayyhu deyisrael.

Detanenan, may dichtiv vela kerav ze el ze kol hallayla. melammed deatu malache illae leshabbecha behahu lelya kame kudesha berich hu, amar lon, vechi (sefer acher bene) ovade yeday tavin beyamma, veatun meshabbechan kamay, miyyad vela kerav ze el ze kol hallayla. ma ketiv, vayhi beashmoret habboker, ashgach kudesha berich hu bizchuta deavraham, deakdim betzafra lemebad reuteh demareh, kedichtiv vayyashkem avraham babboker. keden ahdar yamma, vearku mayin kammayyhu deyisrael.

Dichtiv vayyashav hayyam lifnot boker leetano, vetanenan, leetano: litnao. lehahu tenay dehitna immeh kudesha berich hu, kad bara alma, leetano, ketiv hacha leetano, uchetiv hatam (Tehillim 89:1) maskil leetan haezrachi, veal da lifnot boker, behahu zimna deakdim avraham lemebad reuta demareh, keden itkera yamma, (hacha vayyahom et machane mitzrayim) veal da keshe hava kammeh keriat yam suf.

Kegavvna da, kashin ziuugin kame kudesha berich hu kikriat yam suf, ma keriat yam suf katil leillen behay sitra, umekayem leillen behay sitra, uf hacha beziuugin, ketiv (Tehillim 68:7) motzi asirim bakkosharot, vetanenan bechi veshirot, mayyit hay, veyahiv itteteh lehay, ulezimnin lachayyayva mizdamna leh itteta maalya. aval razin setimin innun becholla vecholla hu bedina, uma deitaru chavrayyay beha, vadday hachi hu.

Uma deitaru lifne, velo (153 amud bet) millefanay, lifne hahu dekaim lifne, kameh dekudesha berich hu, veshimmesh kammeh, veal da la amru dekashin ziuugin lekudesha berich hu. vechen kashin mezonotav shel adam lekudesha berich hu, ella lifne, ulehay kashyayn kol hane, deha lav birshuteh kayyme, af al gav deihu avid, birshuta achara avid. (davar acher 33 aval af al gav deihu avid)

Ketiv (Vayikra 22:3) venichreta hannefesh hahi millefanay. may millefanay. ella da alma deate, hahu dechol chayyin kayymin tamman. davar acher, da tzinnora illaa, nahar dela paskin memoy lealmin. vecholla chad, veda ihu denatil kol iddunin dealma deate. umeinnun iddunin illain tishtetze, (hay nefesh) meatar dehahu noam Adonai tamman, veda ihu millefanay.

Vei tema, i hachi, ha ketiv, (Yona 1:3) vayyakam yona livroach tarshisha millifni Adonai ki yadu haanashim ki millifne Adonai hu boreach, vetanenan may tama azal yona uvarach, vechi man yechul lemivrach mikkame kudesha berich hu, ella hava azil uvarach lenafka meara kaddisha, deha shechinta la sharya levar meara deyisrael, uvegin dela tishre aloy shechinta, hava berach beara kaddisha, deha shechinta ihi sharya tamman, kema deat amer (Tehillim 128:3) eshtecha kegefen poriyya beyarkete vetecha. gefen poriyya da shechinta, ma shechinta hava setima lego bevet kodesh hakkodashim,
839: Uf hachi itteta tzenia, la nafka mittara deveta levar. uvegini kach hava berach yona levar meara kaddisha, veha hacha ketiv millifne, vela ketiv lifne.

Ella vadday hachi hu, millifne, deha ruach nevua la atya miggo shechinta, ella millifne. innun teren dargin dinviim, deka sharyayn al shechinta, umehahu atar dachil lemehve tamman beara kaddisha, veal da millifne. ki millifni Adonai hu boreach, vela lifni Adonai, deha hava yada dinvua la hava ate ella millifne.

Uvegine kach kashin ziuugin, kashin mezonotav shel adam lifni hakadosh baruch hu, veal da david malka tale mezonotav leella, begin dilella la pasik lealmin. aval hacha pasik, deha la talyen beh mezonot. leella innun. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 23:1) Adonai roi la echsar, la yifsekun mezonot minni lealmin, begin dehahu nahar denagid venafik meeden la pasik lealmin, uvegin da kadma shechinta al da.
Ta chaze, beshaata dehay atar mekabbela mezona milleella, kullehu dimkaddeshe lemarehon, kullehu mitaddenin, umitarin, vesallekin gadfin, kad atya shechinta behahu mezona, begin dela yistakkelun bah.

Veinnun telat mashshiryayn bisliku chad, karan veamre (yeshaya 6) kadosh. karan illen lemashiryayta tinyayna, vesallekin gadpin illen kadmae, veillen tinyyayne, veamrin illen tinyyayni kadosh. karan illen lemashiryyayta telitaa, vesallekin gadpin telat mashshiryayn kachada, vechullehu amre kadosh Adonai tzevaot melo chol haaretz kevodo. veal da kullehu meshullavan da beda, illen alin lego illen, veillen alin lego illen, meshullavan da beda, kema deat amar meshullavot ishsha el achotah ken taase lechol karshe hammishkan.
Kerashim kayyme tadir bekiyyumayyhu, vela mitkaffe, kegavvna deinnun omdim, dela mitkaffe delet lon kefitze, vekayyme tadir bela yeshiva, veal da ketiv bakrashim omdim.

Ma ketiv, shete yadot lakkeresh haechad, uf hachi, bitre gevavne innun kelilan chol chad vechad minnayyhu, hahu dileh udechavreh, vechavreh uf hachi beh, veal da meshullavan da im da. (da natil dileh vadechaberayh, veda natil dileh vadechaberayh).

Kegavvna da ketiv beorayyta, (Mishlei 3:14) ki tov sachrah missechar kasef umecharutz tevuatah, da olif leda, veda olif leda, itavadu meshullavan da im da. da natil dileh udechavreh, veda natil dileh udechavreh, umeshullavan da beda.

Ketiv binot deshe yarbitzeni al me menuchot yenahaleni. neot deshe, illen innun mekorin illain, dechol mezona vesippuka atya minnayyhu. neot illen ikrun (Eicha 2:2) neot yaakov. neot deshe, begin deit neot levar deikrun (Yoel 2:22) neot midbar, veal da binot deshe. vei tema ha ketiv tadshe haaretz deshe, deha ihu letatta. ella deshe meinnun neot atya deityeylid veatzmach minnayyhu, veal da binot deshe yarbitzeni.

Al me menuchot yenahaleni, illen mayin denayycha, deka nagdin mehahu atar denagid venafik meeden, veinnun mayin ikrun me menuchot. nafshi yeshovev da hu nefesh david, vela baa david leatkena ella lehahu darga dileh kedka yeot. beillen me menuchot, zeminin tzaddikayya lenayycha lealma deate, dichtiv, (yeshaya noach) venachacha Adonai tamid vegomer.

(Shemot 26:11) veasita karse nechoshet chamishim vegomer. rabbi elazar verabbi abba havo yatve lelya chad. kad ramash lelya, alu go ginna deal yamma ditverya. addehachi, chamu teren kochavaya denatle, da mehacha, veda mehacha, veiarau da beda veitmaru.

Amar rabbi abba, kama ravrevan ovade dekudesha berich hu, bishmayya milleella, uveara millera. man yachil leminda beillen terin kochavaya, denafku chad mehacha, vechad mehacha veiarau da beda, veitmaru. amar leh rabbi elazar vechi la chamena lon, ha ashgachna behu, veashgachna bechamma ovadin acharanin
